descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel crescente team di contabilità fiscale, PwC Switzerland supporta clienti nazionali e internazionali con questioni complesse relative alle imposte sul reddito e alla contabilità, in particolare l'imposta minima globale dell'OCSE (pilastro 2). Il team lavora in diverse località e a stretto contatto con team di esperti assicurativi, fiscali e internazionali. L'obiettivo è fornire consulenza di esperti su vari standard contabili e sviluppare soluzioni pratiche in un ambiente normativo dinamico. La collaborazione è caratterizzata dallo scambio di conoscenze, dall'apprendimento continuo e dal networking internazionale.
• Supportare il team di contabilità fiscale a Zurigo, Zugo o Lucerna concentrandosi sulla verifica fiscale e su questioni relative al pilastro 2 e lavorare occasionalmente in altre sedi in Svizzera.
• Fornire consulenza ai clienti nell'ambito della contabilità fiscale secondo diversi standard contabili come IFRS o US GAAP, Swiss GAAP FER o OR.
• Partecipare ai processi di previsione fiscale e supportare i team di assicurazione nelle verifiche delle voci relative alle imposte sul reddito nei rendiconti finanziari annuali.
• Accompagnare i team di coinvolgimento sugli argomenti del Pilastro 2, in particolare calcoli, analisi dei dati, valutazioni tecniche e argomenti relativi alla conformità.
• Sviluppare contenuti per pubblicazioni esterne e supportare lo sviluppo di materiali di formazione interni, newsletter e materiali tecnici.
• Contribuire all'ulteriore sviluppo e all'applicazione degli strumenti digitali nell'ambiente della commissione fiscale e nell'ambiente del secondo pilastro.
• Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e dinamico con diverse opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo.
• Avere un master o una laurea comparabile in economia, finanza, contabilità o un campo correlato.
• Portare esperienza pratica attraverso stage in audit, contabilità finanziaria o consulenza fiscale.
• Avere almeno 1-2 anni di esperienza con il diritto fiscale svizzero, un'ulteriore esperienza costituisce un vantaggio.
• Comunicare fluentemente in tedesco e inglese scritto e parlato, altre lingue sono un vantaggio.
• Assumersi tempestivamente le responsabilità e muoversi con sicurezza in un ambiente dinamico ed esigente.
• Impressionare con una personalità motivata, resiliente e orientata agli obiettivi, che ama le questioni complesse e ha un alto livello di adattabilità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In the growing tax accounting team, PwC Switzerland supports national and international clients with complex issues relating to income taxes and accounting, in particular the OECD's global minimum tax (Pillar 2). The team works across locations and closely with assurance, tax and international specialist teams. The focus is on providing expert advice on various accounting standards as well as developing practical solutions in a dynamic, regulatory environment. The collaboration is characterized by knowledge exchange, continuous learning and international networking.
• Support the tax accounting team in Zurich, Zug or Lucerne with a focus on Audit of Tax and Pillar 2-related issues and occasionally work at other locations in Switzerland.
• Advise clients in the area of ​​tax accounting under various accounting standards such as IFRS or US GAAP, Swiss GAAP FER or OR.
• Participate in tax provision processes and support assurance teams in audits of income tax items in the annual financial statements.
• Accompany engagement teams on Pillar-2 topics, particularly calculations, data analysis, technical assessments and compliance-related topics.
• Develop content for external publications and support the development of internal training materials, newsletters and technical materials.
• Contribute to the further development and application of digital tools in the tax commission environment and Pillar 2 environment.
• Work in an international, dynamic environment with diverse learning and development opportunities.
• Have a master's degree or a comparable degree in economics, finance, accounting or a related field.
• Bring practical experience through internships in audit, financial accounting or tax consulting.
• Have at least 1-2 years of experience with Swiss tax law, additional experience is an advantage.
• Communicate fluently in written and spoken German and English, other languages ​​are a plus.
• Take on responsibility early and move confidently in a dynamic and demanding environment.
• Impress with a motivated, resilient and goal-oriented personality who enjoys complex issues and has a high level of adaptability.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Au sein de l'équipe de comptabilité fiscale en pleine expansion, PwC Suisse soutient des clients nationaux et internationaux sur des questions complexes liées à l'impôt sur le revenu et à la comptabilité, en particulier l'impôt minimum mondial de l'OCDE (pilier 2). L’équipe travaille sur plusieurs sites et en étroite collaboration avec des équipes spécialisées en matière d’assurance, de fiscalité et internationales. L'accent est mis sur la fourniture de conseils d'experts sur diverses normes comptables ainsi que sur l'élaboration de solutions pratiques dans un environnement réglementaire dynamique. La collaboration se caractérise par l'échange de connaissances, l'apprentissage continu et le réseautage international.
• Soutenir l'équipe de comptabilité fiscale à Zurich, Zoug ou Lucerne en se concentrant sur l'audit des questions fiscales et liées au pilier 2 et travailler occasionnellement sur d'autres sites en Suisse.
• Conseiller les clients dans le domaine de la comptabilité fiscale selon diverses normes comptables telles que les IFRS ou US GAAP, Swiss GAAP FER ou OR.
• Participer aux processus de provisions fiscales et soutenir les équipes d'assurance dans les audits des éléments d'impôt sur le résultat dans les états financiers annuels.
• Accompagner les équipes de mission sur les sujets du Pilier 2, notamment les calculs, l'analyse des données, les évaluations techniques et les sujets liés à la conformité.
• Développer le contenu des publications externes et soutenir le développement de matériel de formation interne, de bulletins d'information et de matériel technique.
• Contribuer au développement et à l'application ultérieurs d'outils numériques dans l'environnement des commissions fiscales et dans l'environnement du Pilier 2.
• Travailler dans un environnement international et dynamique avec diverses opportunités d'apprentissage et de développement.
• Détenir une maîtrise ou un diplôme comparable en économie, finance, comptabilité ou dans un domaine connexe.
• Apporter une expérience pratique à travers des stages en audit, comptabilité financière ou conseil fiscal.
• Avoir au moins 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en droit fiscal suisse, une expérience supplémentaire est un avantage.
• Communiquer couramment en allemand et en anglais écrits et parlés, d'autres langues sont un plus.
• Assumer des responsabilités dès le début et évoluer avec confiance dans un environnement dynamique et exigeant.
• Impressionnez avec une personnalité motivée, résiliente et axée sur les objectifs, qui aime les problèmes complexes et possède un haut niveau d'adaptabilité.

jobs.title: Career start - Audit Trade, Industries and Services - October 2026
jobs.description:
En matière d'audit, nous fournissons l'assurance indépendante et objective que les dossiers, les états et les processus financiers sont exacts, fiables et conformes, afin d'instaurer la confiance des parties prenantes. Nous contribuons donc à l'intégrité des systèmes financiers, facilitons la prise de décision en connaissance de cause, protégeons contre la fraude et promouvons la confiance dans l'environnement des entreprises.

• Contrôler les états financiers consolidés et annuels des entreprises nationales et internationales directement chez le client, au sein des locaux PwC ou à domicile.

• Évaluer les processus d'entreprise, analyser, documenter et porter un jugement sur des questions comptables.

• Aider à répondre aux questions concernant la comptabilité selon différentes normes (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP RPC, US GAAP) et effectuer des missions spéciales et des audits.

• Participer à la révolution numérique de l'audit en utilisant nos outils et approches d'audit numérique en contribuant à leur amélioration.

• Contrôler les rapports de durabilité concernant les normes environnementales, sociales et de gouvernance (ESG) et assurer le suivi des stratégies de durabilité.

• Bénéficier d'un coaching sur le lieu de travail et en dehors de celui-ci afin d'atteindre les objectifs de carrière et de développement professionnel et personnel.

• Constituer un réseau interne et externe, acquérir un savoir-faire technique et des compétences relationnelles dans le cadre des mandats et acquérir ainsi une expertise dans le domaine de la finance et de la comptabilité.

• Titulaire, ou sur le point de l'être, d'un Bachelor ou Master dans le domaine de l'économie ou finance, de l'informatique de gestion ou des STEM.

• Obtenir le diplôme d'expert-comptable (pris en charge par PwC) est un objectif. En dehors de la " busy season ", notre temps de travail annualisé donne la flexibilité d'étudier et d'avoir du temps libre ou une compensation financière.

• Un premier stage dans la comptabilité ou dans un domaine similaire est un atout.

• De langue maternelle française, avec d'excellentes connaissances en anglais.

• Intérêt pour l'actualité, les tendances technologiques ainsi que pour le développement durable.

• Faire preuve de résilience, de persévérance et d'adaptabilité.
­
Ton évolution :

Nous savons que le début de la vie professionnelle peut être excitant, mais aussi exigeant. C'est pourquoi nous t'accompagnons sur ton chemin – avec un plan clair et un soutien solide :
• Soutien temporel et financier : Nous te soutenons pleinement dans ta formation pour devenir expert·e-comptable diplômé·e. Tu bénéficies non seulement d'un appui financier, mais aussi de la flexibilité nécessaire pour organiser ton temps d'apprentissage de manière optimale.

• Une flexibilité adaptée à toi : Nos modèles d'organisation du temps de travail te donnent la liberté de concilier emploi, études et loisirs.

• Mentorat et développement : Tu es accompagné·e par des collègues expérimenté·e·s qui te soutiennent et t'inspirent.

• Une équipe qui te renforce : Chez nous, tu trouves une communauté qui valorise la diversité, célèbre les idées et t'encourage à te dépasser.

Pourquoi PwC ? Parce que nous savons ce qui compte pour toi. Un travail qui a du sens et fait une différence. Une équipe qui t'inspire. Et la possibilité de façonner activement l'avenir.
Postule dès maintenant et deviens membre de notre Community of Solvers. Ensemble, construisons l'avenir de l'audit – digital, durable et global.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Legal Regulatory Project Manager
jobs.description:
You will join a multidisciplinary team operating at the intersection of legal, regulatory and business topics. The team supports organisations in navigating regulatory change and turning complex requirements into practical, scalable and sustainable business solutions. Working closely with colleagues across PwC's Legal, Compliance, Consulting and Technology teams, you will contribute to integrated, end to end regulatory transformation projects in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

• Analyse new and evolving regulatory requirements and translate them into clear business, process and operating model implications.

• Design pragmatic target processes, controls and governance structures that embed regulatory requirements into day to day operations.

• Enable end to end regulatory implementation projects, from regulatory interpretation and solution design to operational rollout and adoption.

• Shape and coordinate cross functional teams across legal, compliance, business, operations and IT to deliver implementable solutions.

• Convert complex legal and regulatory texts into actionable business requirements, policies, procedures and system specifications.

• Drive implementation roadmaps and support execution, ensuring solutions are risk appropriate, scalable and aligned with business objectives.

• Contribute to change and adoption by supporting training concepts, communication materials and implementation guidance.

• Build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders and act as a reliable point of contact throughout regulatory initiatives.

• University degree in Law, Business Administration or a related field.

• At least 3 years of experience in a regulated environment with hands on involvement in regulatory or compliance implementation initiatives.

• Strong capability to translate regulatory requirements into business processes, operating models and practical solutions.

• Solid understanding of how regulation impacts business operations, controls, systems and organisational structures.

• Proven experience in project based environments with strong coordination and delivery skills.

• Confidence working at the interface of legal, compliance, business and technology teams.

• Fluency in English; German is a strong advantage.

jobs.description:
PwC Legal Schweiz ist Teil des globalen PwC-Legal-Netzwerks und verbindet rechtliche Expertise mit interdisziplinären Kompetenzen aus Steuern, Beratung und Wirtschaftsprüfung. Das Team Datenschutz und ICT-Recht berät nationale und internationale Kund:innen bei komplexen Fragestellungen rund um Datenschutz, digitale Regulierung und technologiegetriebene Transformationen. In einem dynamischen, vernetzten Umfeld arbeitest du eng mit Spezialist:innen aus verschiedenen PwC-Bereichen zusammen und trägst dazu bei, praxisnahe und zukunftsorientierte Lösungen für eine zunehmend digitale Wirtschaft zu entwickeln.

• Beratung und Betreuung nationaler und internationaler Kund:innen aus verschiedenen Branchen wie Industrie, Finanzwesen, Medien, Telekommunikation und Gesundheitswesen zu datenschutz- und ICT‑rechtlichen Fragestellungen.

• Aktive Mitwirkung bei der Akquisition neuer Mandate sowie Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger, vertrauensvoller Kundenbeziehungen.

• Leitung und Koordination von Mandaten sowie komplexen Datenschutz‑, Implementierungs‑ und Transformationsprojekten mit Verantwortung für eine qualitativ hochwertige und praxisnahe Umsetzung.

• Fachliche Begleitung, Coaching und Weiterentwicklung jüngerer Mitarbeitender durch Wissensaustausch, Mentoring und Leadership im Projektalltag.

• Enge interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Fachspezialist:innen aus anderen PwC‑Bereichen zur Entwicklung integrierter und ganzheitlicher Lösungen.

• Beitrag zur Thought Leadership durch das Verfassen von Publikationen sowie die Durchführung von Präsentationen und Schulungen zu Themen der Datenbearbeitung, etwa in den Bereichen Marketing, Social Media, Outsourcing oder Personalwesen.

• Abgeschlossenes juristisches oder betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit starkem Interesse an Datenschutz, ICT-Recht und regulatorischen Entwicklungen.

• Erste relevante Berufserfahrung sowie fundierte Praxiserfahrung im Datenschutzrecht, insbesondere im Schweizer Datenschutzgesetz und in der EU-Datenschutz-Grundverordnung.

• Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Leitung oder Koordination von datenschutzrechtlichen Implementierungs- oder Transformationsprojekten.

• Zusätzliche fachliche Weiterbildungen wie ein CAS Datenschutzrecht, IAPP-Zertifizierungen oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen von Vorteil.

• Ausgeprägte Affinität zu Digitalisierung, neuen Technologien und deren rechtlichen und regulatorischen Auswirkungen.

• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams.

The data protection and ICT law team advises national and international clients on complex issues relating to data protection, digital regulation and technology-driven transformations. In a dynamic, networked environment, you will work closely with specialists from various PwC areas and help develop practical and future-oriented solutions for an increasingly digital economy.
• Advising and supporting national and international customers from various sectors such as industry, finance, media, telecommunications and healthcare on data protection and ICT law issues.
• Active participation in the acquisition of new mandates as well as establishing and maintaining long-term, trusting customer relationships.
• Management and coordination of mandates as well as complex data protection, implementation and transformation projects with responsibility for high-quality and practical implementation.
• Professional support, coaching and further development of younger employees through knowledge exchange, mentoring and leadership in everyday project life.
• Close interdisciplinary collaboration with specialists from other PwC areas to develop integrated and holistic solutions.
• Contribute to thought leadership by writing publications and conducting presentations and training on data processing topics, such as marketing, social media, outsourcing or human resources.
• Completed law or business studies with a strong interest in data protection, ICT law and regulatory developments.
• Initial relevant professional experience as well as well-founded practical experience in data protection law, in particular the Swiss Data Protection Act and the EU General Data Protection Regulation.
• Proven experience in leading or coordinating data protection implementation or transformation projects.
• Additional professional training such as CAS data protection law, IAPP certifications or comparable qualifications would be an advantage.
• Strong affinity for digitalization, new technologies and their legal and regulatory implications.
• Very good communication skills and enjoy working in interdisciplinary and international teams.
descriptionByLocale.de:
PwC Legal Schweiz ist Teil des globalen PwC-Legal-Netzwerks und verbindet rechtliche Expertise mit interdisziplinären Kompetenzen aus Steuern, Beratung und Wirtschaftsprüfung. Das Team Datenschutz und ICT-Recht berät nationale und internationale Kund:innen bei komplexen Fragestellungen rund um Datenschutz, digitale Regulierung und technologiegetriebene Transformationen. In einem dynamischen, vernetzten Umfeld arbeitest du eng mit Spezialist:innen aus verschiedenen PwC-Bereichen zusammen und trägst dazu bei, praxisnahe und zukunftsorientierte Lösungen für eine zunehmend digitale Wirtschaft zu entwickeln.
• Beratung und Betreuung nationaler und internationaler Kund:innen aus verschiedenen Branchen wie Industrie, Finanzwesen, Medien, Telekommunikation und Gesundheitswesen zu datenschutz- und ICT‑rechtlichen Fragestellungen.
• Aktive Mitwirkung bei der Akquisition neuer Mandate sowie Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger, vertrauensvoller Kundenbeziehungen.
• Leitung und Koordination von Mandaten sowie komplexen Datenschutz‑, Implementierungs‑ und Transformationsprojekten mit Verantwortung für eine qualitativ hochwertige und praxisnahe Umsetzung.
• Fachliche Begleitung, Coaching und Weiterentwicklung jüngerer Mitarbeitender durch Wissensaustausch, Mentoring und Leadership im Projektalltag.
• Enge interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Fachspezialist:innen aus anderen PwC‑Bereichen zur Entwicklung integrierter und ganzheitlicher Lösungen.
• Beitrag zur Thought Leadership durch das Verfassen von Publikationen sowie die Durchführung von Präsentationen und Schulungen zu Themen der Datenbearbeitung, etwa in den Bereichen Marketing, Social Media, Outsourcing oder Personalwesen.
• Abgeschlossenes juristisches oder betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit starkem Interesse an Datenschutz, ICT-Recht und regulatorischen Entwicklungen.
• Erste relevante Berufserfahrung sowie fundierte Praxiserfahrung im Datenschutzrecht, insbesondere im Schweizer Datenschutzgesetz und in der EU-Datenschutz-Grundverordnung.
• Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Leitung oder Koordination von datenschutzrechtlichen Implementierungs- oder Transformationsprojekten.
• Zusätzliche fachliche Weiterbildungen wie ein CAS Datenschutzrecht, IAPP-Zertifizierungen oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen von Vorteil.
• Ausgeprägte Affinität zu Digitalisierung, neuen Technologien und deren rechtlichen und regulatorischen Auswirkungen.
• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
PwC Legal Suisse fait partie du réseau mondial PwC Legal et combine une expertise juridique avec des compétences interdisciplinaires en matière de fiscalité, de conseil et d'audit. L’équipe Droit de la protection des données et des TIC conseille des clients nationaux et internationaux sur des questions complexes liées à la protection des données, à la réglementation numérique et aux transformations technologiques. Dans un environnement dynamique et en réseau, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des spécialistes de divers domaines de PwC et contribuerez à développer des solutions pratiques et tournées vers l'avenir pour une économie de plus en plus numérique.
• Conseiller et soutenir des clients nationaux et internationaux de divers secteurs tels que l'industrie, la finance, les médias, les télécommunications et la santé sur les questions de protection des données et de droit des TIC.
• Participation active à l'acquisition de nouveaux mandats ainsi qu'à l'établissement et au maintien de relations de confiance à long terme avec la clientèle.
• Gestion et coordination de mandats ainsi que de projets complexes de protection des données, de mise en œuvre et de transformation avec la responsabilité d'une mise en œuvre pratique et de haute qualité.
• Soutien professionnel, coaching et développement continu des jeunes collaborateurs grâce à l'échange de connaissances, au mentorat et au leadership dans la vie quotidienne du projet.
• Collaboration interdisciplinaire étroite avec des spécialistes d'autres domaines de PwC pour développer des solutions intégrées et holistiques.
• Contribuer au leadership éclairé en rédigeant des publications et en organisant des présentations et des formations sur des sujets liés au traitement des données, tels que le marketing, les médias sociaux, l'externalisation ou les ressources humaines.
• Études de droit ou de commerce terminées avec un fort intérêt pour la protection des données, le droit des TIC et les évolutions réglementaires.
• Première expérience professionnelle pertinente ainsi qu'une expérience pratique bien fondée en matière de droit de la protection des données, en particulier de la loi suisse sur la protection des données et du règlement général sur la protection des données de l'UE.
• Expérience avérée dans la direction ou la coordination de projets de mise en œuvre ou de transformation de la protection des données.
• Une formation professionnelle supplémentaire telle que la loi CAS sur la protection des données, les certifications IAPP ou des qualifications comparables serait un avantage.
• Forte affinité pour la digitalisation, les nouvelles technologies et leurs implications juridiques et réglementaires.
• Très bonnes compétences en communication et plaisir à travailler dans des équipes interdisciplinaires et internationales.

jobs.title: Director CIO Advisory Middle Markets
jobs.description:
PwC Consulting has a strong foundation of clients in the middle market and family business sectors. In addition to serving large multinational corporations, we aim to further strengthen our presence in the second and third tier client segments.
To support this goal, we are seeking a Director / Partner specializing in Technology Strategy & Transformation / CIO Advisory .

• Lead and support exciting technology strategy and transformation projects for our clients in the middle markets sector.

• Work closely with executives in the technology environment and develop digital strategies as well as effective business models.

• Develop creative, high-quality solutions to current challenges of our clients in the key areas of technology strategy, organization, operating-model, assessment and other related topics.

• Actively drive the acquisition of new projects and clients.

• Be involved in the further development of the service offering for Technology Strategy & Transformation Advisory.

• Work in an inspiring team and an international network, receive regular feedback from colleagues and superiors and have access to first-class training in the areas of technical know-how and soft skills.

• Take responsibility for employees in the role of coach and accompany your coachees in their professional and career development.

• Successful career in consulting and excellent methodological and technical skills.

• Scientific and/or technical background or in economics and experience in leading and supporting strategic technology or transformation projects.

• Able to quickly grasp complex scenarios and interrelationships and address them with solution-oriented and entrepreneurial thinking.

• Proven expertise in common methodologies and frameworks (TOGAF, COBIT, SAFe, IPMA, PRINCE, SCRUM, etc.).

• Interest in the further development of the team and the expansion of the service offering and show initiative to shape them both.

• Experience in leadership and/or coaching of employees.

• Convincing appearance and excellent communication skills, which makes you a competent conversation partner for our clients.

• Very good oral and written skills in German and English, preferably also in French.

• Committed, communicative personality with high flexibility and resilience, you like to work in teams but also independently and at changing locations.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Compliance Center (Spezialist:in Steuerdeklarationen)
jobs.description:
Du wirst Teil unseres Corporate-Tax-Compliance-Teams in Basel innerhalb von Tax, Legal and Workforce. Unser Team verbindet fundiertes steuertechnisches Know-how mit einem pragmatischen Lösungsansatz und arbeitet eng mit anderen PwC Spezialist:innen aus Bereichen wie Deals, Legal und Accounting zusammen. Dich erwartet ein kollegiales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher fachlicher Qualität und einer ausgeprägten Coaching- und Feedbackkultur, in dem auch erfahrene Profile ihre Expertise gezielt einbringen und weiterentwickeln können.

• Verantwortung für die Erstellung und Review von Steuererklärungen, sowie die Beurteilung von Steuerveranlagungen von juristischen Personen.

• Aktive Rolle in der steuerlichen Abschlussplanung, inklusive Berechnung und Beurteilung von Steuerrückstellungen.

• Eigenständige Bearbeitung komplexer Fragestellungen im Bereich Corporate Tax und Steuer-Compliance.

• Fachliche Mitarbeit bei Unternehmensstrukturierungen, Reorganisationen, Transaktionen und Steuerplanungsprojekten.

• Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen, fristgerechten und regelkonformen Steuer-Compliance unter Berücksichtigung der aktuellen Gesetzgebung.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern sowie punktuelle fachliche Unterstützung weniger erfahrener Teammitglieder.

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Steuerbereich (z. B. Treuhand, Fachhochschule, Universität) oder kaufmännische Grundausbildung mit fundierter Weiterbildung.

• Ca. 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Steuerdeklaration und im Bereich Steuer-Compliance von juristischen Personen, vorzugsweise in einem Beratungs-, Treuhand- oder Industrieumfeld.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

• Sehr gutes Verständnis steuerlicher Zusammenhänge sowie Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte strukturiert zu analysieren und pragmatisch umzusetzen.

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Qualitätsbewusstsein und sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen und Steuerbehörden.

• Sehr gute MS Office Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit Steuersoftware und digitalen Compliance Prozessen von Vorteil.

Un environnement collégial avec une courte prise de décision, une qualité professionnelle élevée et une solide culture de coaching et de rétroaction vous attendent, dans lequel des profils expérimentés peuvent contribuer et développer leur expertise de manière ciblée. ## Mansioni - Responsabilité de la création et de l'examen des déclarations de revenus, ainsi que de l'évaluation des incidences fiscales des personnes morales. - Rôle actif dans la planification financière finale, y compris le calcul et l'évaluation des dispositions fiscales. - traitement indépendant de questions complexes dans le domaine de l'impôt sur les sociétés et de la conformité fiscale. - Coopération professionnelle dans les structures d'entreprise, les réorganisations, les transactions et les projets de planification fiscale. - Assurer une conformité fiscale de haute qualité, opportune et régulière avec la législation actuelle. - Une coopération étroite avec les acteurs internes et externes ainsi qu'un soutien technique ponctuel pour les membres moins expérimentés de l'équipe. ##

jobs.title: Intern/Trainee - Corporate Tax
jobs.description:
Au sein de PwC, tu rejoindras une équipe dynamique et collaborative, spécialisée dans l'accompagnement de clients locaux et internationaux sur des problématiques fiscales variées et stimulantes. Dans un environnement en constante évolution, tu contribueras à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée, tout en développant tes compétences techniques, digitales et relationnelles aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés.

• Conseiller les entreprises sur des aspects fiscaux, économiques et juridiques complexes, en leur apportant des solutions innovantes, notamment grâce à l'utilisation d'outils technologiques modernes et de solutions basées sur l'intelligence artificielle.

• Guider nos clients en matière de conformité fiscale, de comptabilité fiscale, et les accompagner dans la transformation de leur fonction fiscale, afin d'optimiser la gestion de leurs obligations et de soutenir l'évolution de leurs processus à l'aide d'outils digitaux performants.

• Travailler au sein d'une équipe jeune et dynamique, et participer à la recherche ainsi qu'à l'élaboration de conseils fiscaux sous forme d'accords fiscaux, de mémorandums, d'opinions ou de présentations destinées aux clients.

• Collaborer efficacement avec différentes parties prenantes, en faisant preuve de solides compétences en communication, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit, afin de transmettre des sujets techniques de manière claire, structurée et accessible.

• Profiter d'excellentes perspectives de carrière : après six mois, si tu te sens à l'aise dans la fonction, tu pourrais évoluer vers un poste de consultant.

• Recevoir un accompagnement personnalisé tout au long de ton stage, tout en enrichissant tes compétences techniques via des formations continues sur des sujets fiscaux actuels, ainsi que sur les nouveaux outils technologiques, proposées par nos Managers et Associés.

• Actuellement en fin d'études ou titulaire d'une maîtrise universitaire en sciences économiques, business administration ou droit, en Suisse.

• Posséder un intérêt marqué pour la fiscalité nationale et internationale, ainsi que la volonté de continuer à approfondir tes compétences dans ce domaine.

• Avoir l'ambition de devenir un expert fiscal et, à ce titre, envisager une formation professionnelle menant à l'obtention du diplôme fédéral d'expert fiscal.

• Faire preuve d'une affinité naturelle avec les chiffres et maîtriser les outils informatiques usuels tels qu'Excel et PowerPoint, tout en ayant un intérêt prononcé pour les outils technologiques en général, les solutions digitales, l'intelligence artificielle et l'analyse de données.

• Être à l'aise avec l'apprentissage et l'utilisation de nouveaux outils technologiques, et avoir la curiosité de comprendre comment l'IA et les technologies émergentes peuvent soutenir et transformer les métiers de la fiscalité.

• Maîtriser l'anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit, en plus de ta langue maternelle française. L'allemand constituerait un atout.

• Disposer de très bonnes compétences en communication et de présentation, avec la capacité d'échanger de manière claire, professionnelle et efficace avec les clients comme avec les collègues.

• Avoir envie de travailler en équipe, de contribuer à la résolution de dossiers complexes et d'apporter un soutien de qualité à tes clients et à tes collègues.

Faire preuve d'une attitude orientée service, d'un sens naturel de l'initiative et d'un fort engagement dans ton travail, avec le souci constant de fournir un travail d'excellente qualité.

Démontrer une réelle capacité d'apprentissage, d'adaptation et de collaboration, aussi bien dans un environnement d'équipe qu'en autonomie.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Strategy Consulting
jobs.description:
Strategy& ist die globale Strategieberatung von PwC. In der Schweiz unterstützen wir vor allem führende Schweizer Unternehmen dabei, ihre internationale Präsenz zu gestalten – von der Strategie am Hauptsitz bis zur Transformation globaler Geschäftsbereiche. Wir entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Strategien für führende Unternehmen auf Basis klar differenzierender Wettbewerbsvorteile.

Unser Team zeichnet sich durch besonders engen Zusammenhalt aus: von Office Events an spannenden Locations über regelmässige Team Dinner und Team Building Events – bei uns kommt der Spass an der Arbeit nicht zu kurz.

Als Senior Associate im Strategy& Team arbeitest du mit führenden nationalen und internationalen Organisationen verschiedener Branchen zusammen. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du Analysen, Strategien und Konzepte entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette – von Geschäfts- und Betriebsmodellen über Technologie- und Digitalstrategien bis hin zu Transformationsprogrammen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für klar definierte Projektmodule oder Workstreams und treibst deren inhaltliche Bearbeitung eigenständig voran. Dabei strukturierst du Problemstellungen, führst fundierte Analysen durch und leitest datenbasierte Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Im engen Austausch mit Projektleitung und Team stellst du sicher, dass Ergebnisse konsistent, belastbar und umsetzungsorientiert sind.

Zudem arbeitest du eng mit Kund:innen zusammen, bereitest Ergebnisse adressatengerecht auf und unterstützt bei der Präsentation zentraler Erkenntnisse gegenüber Management- und Entscheidungsgremien. Dabei erhältst du früh Verantwortung für zentrale Analysen und Inhalte innerhalb der Projektarbeit.

Darüber hinaus bringst du dich aktiv in die Teamarbeit ein, unterstützt jüngere Kolleg:innen und trägst zu einer offenen und kollaborativen Teamkultur bei. Durch Trainings und Projektarbeit entwickelst du kontinuierlich deine Methoden-, Branchen- und Consultingkompetenzen weiter.

In Projekten analysierst du komplexe Fragestellungen unserer Kund:innen und entwickelst strukturierte Lösungsansätze mit nachhaltigem Mehrwert. Typische Themen sind:
• Entwicklung von Unternehmens-, Geschäftsbereichs- und Digitalstrategien

• Analyse und Weiterentwicklung von Business- und Operating-Modellen

• Unterstützung bei Transformations- und Change-Programmen

• Mitarbeit bei M&A-Initiativen, Carve-Outs und Portfoliostrategien

• Analyse und Optimierung von Organisationen, Prozessen und Wertschöpfungsketten

• Einsatz von Daten, Analytics und neuen Technologien zur Entscheidungsunterstützung

Du unterstützt außerdem bei der Erstellung von Analysen, Präsentationen und Konzepten im Rahmen von Angebotsentwicklungen und trägst so zur Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen bei.

• Akademischer Hintergrund: Überdurchschnittlich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Master, MBA oder PhD) in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, Natur- oder Sozialwissenschaften, Statistik/Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.

• Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in einer Top-Strategieberatung oder in anspruchsvollen Unternehmensfunktionen, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Strategie, Transformation, Digitalisierung oder Performance Improvement. Erfahrung in der strukturierten Bearbeitung komplexer Fragestellungen sowie in der eigenständigen Bearbeitung von Projektmodulen.

• Internationale Erfahrung: Auslandserfahrung durch Studium, Praktika oder Beruf sowie Interesse an der Arbeit in internationalen und interkulturellen Kontexten.

• Kommunikationsstärke: Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch. Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte klar aufzubereiten und strukturiert zu präsentieren.

• Analytische Kompetenz: Stark ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte schnell zu erfassen und in fundierte Analysen sowie umsetzbare Empfehlungen zu überführen.

• Digitale Affinität: Sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Tools (z. B. Excel, PowerPoint) sowie offen für moderne Datenanalyse- und AI-Tools; Kenntnisse in Datenverarbeitung, Statistiksoftware oder Programmiersprachen sind von Vorteil.

• Persönliches Profil: Hohe Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und Teamorientierung. Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie der Anspruch, gemeinsam im Team nachhaltige Wirkung bei Kund:innen zu erzielen.

Sviluppiamo strategie su misura per aziende leader basate su chiaramente differenziando i vantaggi competitivi. Il nostro team è caratterizzato da una coesione particolarmente ravvicinata: dagli eventi di ufficio alle emozionanti location attraverso la cena di squadra regolare e gli eventi di team building – il divertimento al lavoro non è troppo breve. ## Mansioni - No. Riceverai presto la responsabilità per l'analisi centrale e il contenuto all'interno del progetto. - No. Inoltre, si contribuisce attivamente al lavoro di squadra, sostenere i colleghi più giovani e contribuire a una cultura del team aperta e collaborativa. - Attraverso la formazione e il lavoro di progetto, si sviluppa continuamente il vostro metodo, industria e competenze di consulenza. - No. Nei progetti, si analizzano questioni complesse dei nostri clienti e si sviluppano soluzioni strutturate con valore aggiunto sostenibile. - Gli argomenti tipici sono: - lo sviluppo di strategie aziendali, aziendali e digitali - l'analisi e lo sviluppo di modelli aziendali e operativi - il supporto per i programmi di trasformazione e di cambiamento - la cooperazione con iniziative M&A, carve-out e strategie di portafoglio - l'analisi e l'ottimizzazione di organizzazioni, processi e catene di valore - l'uso di dati, analisi e nuove tecnologie per il supporto decisionale - Descrizione Strategy& is the global strategy consultancy of PwC. In Switzerland, we mainly support leading Swiss companies in shaping their international presence – from the strategy at the headquarters to the transformation of global business areas. We develop tailor-made strategies for leading companies based on clearly differentiating competitive advantages. Our team is characterized by particularly close cohesion: from office events to exciting locations via regular team dinner and team building events – the fun at work is not too short. ## Mansioni - As a senior associate in Strategy& Team, you work with leading national and international organizations from different industries. - Together with your team, you develop analyses, strategies and concepts along the entire value chain – from business and operating models to technology and digital strategies to transformation programs. - You take responsibility for clearly defined project modules or workstreams and drive their content forward. - In doing so, you structure problems, carry out sound analyses and guide data-based action recommendations. - In close cooperation with project management and team, you make sure that results are consistent, loadable and implementation-oriented. - In addition, you work closely with customers: both, prepare results for addressing and support the presentation of key insights towards management and decision-making bodies. - You will receive early responsibility for central analysis and content within the project work. - In addition, you actively contribute to teamwork, support younger colleagues and contribute to an open and collaborative team culture. - Through training and project work, you continuously develop your method, industry and consulting skills. - In projects, you analyze complex questions of our customers and develop structured solutions with sustainable added value. - Typical topics are: - development of corporate, business and digital strategies - analysis and development of business and operating models - support for transformation and change programs - cooperation with M&A initiatives, carve-outs and portfolio strategies - analysis and optimization of organizations, processes and value chains - use of data, analytics and new technologies for decision support - you also support the development of analytics, presentations and solutions. ##
• Requisiti - Academic background: above-average university degree (Master, MBA or PhD) in economics, (economic) informatics, (economic)engineering, natural sciences or social sciences, statistics/data science or a comparable subject area. - Professional experience: multi-year relevant professional experience in a top strategy consulting or in challenging corporate functions, ideally related to strategy, transformation, digitization or performance improvement. Experience in the structured processing of complex questions and in the independent processing of project modules. - International experience: experience abroad through studies, internships or profession, as well as interest in working in international and intercultural contexts. - Communication strength: Very good oral and written communication skills in German and English. Ability to present complex content clearly and structuredly. - Analytical Competence: Strong Analytical Skills and Structured Operation with the ability to quickly capture complex facts and to translate them into sound analyses and feasible recommendations. - Digital affinity: Safe to use common tools (e.g. Excel, PowerPoint) as well as open to modern data analysis and AI tools; Knowledge of data processing, statistical software or programming languages is advantageous. - Personal profile: High initiative, willingness to learn and team orientation. Embossed customer orientation as well as the claim to achieve sustainable impact on customers together with the team.

jobs.title: Associate / Senior Associate – Assurance, Audit Proposal Manager (German & English)
jobs.description:
Join the Assurance Activation Hub within Internal Firm Services (IFS) at PwC Switzerland. The team supports the Audit business by creating high-quality proposals and client materials, blending communication, sales, audit, and design to craft compelling client stories. Collaboration with Assurance teams, Partners, and global functions drives impact in a dynamic, inclusive environment that values diversity and innovation. We offer flexible working hours with a hybrid model. A minimum of 2 days per week in a Swiss PwC office is required, ideally in the Bern/Zurich area, depending on projects and plans.

• Lead end to end proposal and pursuit processes for Audit and Assurance engagements, from planning to final delivery, ensuring quality, consistency and timely execution across multiple stakeholders

• Shape compelling, client focused content in German and English, including written proposals, presentation decks, video or demo scripts and other pursuit related materials

• Enable effective collaboration with audit teams, subject matter experts, sales coaches, transformation specialists and designers to translate complex offerings into clear value propositions

• Apply a tech savvy and innovative mindset by leveraging AI tools and digital solutions to increase efficiency and enhance the client experience

• Research clients, industries and market trends to tailor proposals and differentiate PwC in a competitive landscape

• Review and refine proposal materials to ensure accuracy, impact and alignment with PwC policies and brand guidelines

• Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing best practices, constructively challenging existing approaches and introducing new ideas across pursuits

• 2–4 years of experience in proposal management, bid management or proposal writing, ideally within the services industry; experience in business development, account management, project management or marketing can also be leveraged

• Full professional proficiency in German and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; knowledge of French or Italian is an advantage

• Strong project management capabilities, with the ability to prioritise, manage multiple deadlines and take ownership in dynamic environments

• Client centric mindset combined with curiosity to understand internal and external stakeholder needs and translate them into impactful solutions

• High attention to detail and a strong quality orientation

• Collaborative and open minded working style, with confidence to engage and constructively challenge senior stakeholders

• Solid PowerPoint skills and a strong interest in digital tools and AI enabled ways of working, including systematic use of Copilot and ChatGPT equivalent solutions

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Junior Proposal Manager (Advisory Major Pursuits)
jobs.description:

The team works closely with partners, directors, and engagement teams across industries to shape winning client proposals. Combining project management, storytelling and digital expertise, the team supports complex and strategic pursuits end to end, while continuously improving tools, processes and ways of working to enhance proposal quality and efficiency.

• Lead proposal services for large and/or strategic advisory pursuits across industries, delivering high‑quality, RFP‑compliant responses

• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams of contributors and oversee content development, information gathering, design coordination and quality reviews throughout the pursuit lifecycle

• Manage advisory pursuit processes end to end, ensuring adherence to RFP deadlines and effective resource allocation

• Provide coaching on pursuit processes and related tasks, including prioritising and overseeing design support from onshore and offshore delivery centres

jobs.title: Manager - Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
This role contributes to shaping and evolving the firm's enterprise-wide architecture across business, data, application, integration, technology and security domains. The team connects strategy with execution by translating architectural direction into clear standards, reference architectures, patterns and roadmaps that delivery teams can apply in practice.
Close collaboration with product and delivery teams, as well as with digital compliance and information security stakeholders, is a core part of the role. The position also works with PwC stakeholders beyond Switzerland to ensure alignment with global strategies and standards while addressing local regulatory and business requirements.

• Contribute to the definition and evolution of the future-state enterprise architecture, translating business strategy and operating model needs into principles, standards and reference architectures

• Maintain and evolve transparency of the IT landscape across applications, platforms, integrations and key data flows, including inventories, capability maps and dependency views

• Ensure the IT landscape is accurately captured and usable in enterprise architecture repositories and tools, applying data quality practices and creating stakeholder-friendly views

• Support architecture governance and compliance by helping teams align designs with agreed standards and guardrails, and by documenting exceptions and trade-offs clearly

• Act as a trusted advisor to delivery teams and stakeholders, ensuring non-functional requirements such as security, resilience, performance, maintainability and cost are addressed early and consistently

• Translate architectural direction into consumable assets, including minimum viable patterns, reusable building blocks, templates and reference implementations, to accelerate delivery and reduce rework

• Evaluate technologies and standards, recommend fit-for-purpose solutions, and support standard configurations to improve resilience, scalability and cost-effectiveness

• Provide hands-on architecture expertise across the Azure and Microsoft ecosystem, including identity, landing zones, integration patterns and security-by-design

• Collaborate effectively in a global, multi-stakeholder environment, aligning local architecture decisions with PwC global platforms, reference architectures and policies

• 2-5 years of experience in enterprise architecture and/or solution or domain architecture, with the ability to connect strategy, governance and delivery

• Strong capability to lead architecture discussions, influence stakeholders and drive alignment across teams without direct authority

• Practical experience with enterprise architecture repositories and tools such as Ardoq or comparable solutions

• Solid modelling skills, for example using ArchiMate, and the ability to create clear, decision-ready architecture diagrams

• Strong knowledge and proven experience with Azure and the Microsoft technology stack, ideally supported by advanced-level certifications such as Azure Solution Architect

• Hands-on experience in technical areas including cloud, infrastructure, networking, identity, APIs and integration, and security patterns

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex topics and communicate them clearly

• A university degree in business informatics, computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Excellent communication skills with proficiency in English; German proficiency is an advantage

Il team collega strategia ed esecuzione traducendo la direzione architettonica in standard chiari, architetture di riferimento, pattern e roadmap che i team di consegna possono applicare nella pratica. La stretta collaborazione con i team di prodotto e consegna, così come con gli stakeholder della conformità digitale e della sicurezza informatica, è una parte fondamentale del ruolo. La posizione lavora anche con stakeholder PwC oltre la Svizzera per garantire l'allineamento con le strategie e gli standard globali, affrontando al contempo i requisiti normativi e aziendali locali. ## Mansioni - Contribuire alla definizione e all'evoluzione dell'architettura aziendale a stato futuro, traducendo le esigenze della strategia aziendale e dei modelli operativi in principi, standard e architetture di riferimento - Mantenere ed evolvere la trasparenza del panorama IT tra applicazioni, piattaforme, integrazioni e flussi di dati chiave, inclusi inventari, mappe di capacità e viste delle dipendenze - Garantire che il panorama IT sia accuratamente catturato e utilizzabile nei repository di architettura aziendale e strumenti, applicare pratiche di qualità dei dati e creare visioni favorevoli agli stakeholder - Supportare la governance e la conformità dell'architettura aiutando i team ad allineare i progetti con standard e guardrail concordati, e documentando chiaramente eccezioni e compromessi - Agire come consulente affidabile per team di esecuzione e stakeholder, assicurando che requisiti non funzionali come sicurezza, resilienza, prestazioni, manutenibilità e costi vengano affrontati in modo precoce e coerente - Tradurre la direzione architettonica in Risorse consumabili, inclusi pattern minimamente validi, blocchi di costruzione riutilizzabili, template e implementazioni di riferimento, per accelerare la consegna e ridurre i rilavori - Valutare tecnologie e standard, raccomandare soluzioni adatte allo scopo e supportare configurazioni standard per migliorare resilienza, scalabilità ed efficacia - Fornire competenze pratiche sull'architettura dell'ecosistema Azure e Microsoft, inclusi identità, landing zone, pattern di integrazione e security-by-design - Collaborare efficacemente in un ambiente globale e multi-stakeholder, allineando le decisioni di architettura locale con le piattaforme globali PwC, le architetture di riferimento e le politiche ##
• Requisiti - Esperienza in architettura aziendale e/o architettura di soluzioni o domini, con capacità di collegare strategia, governance e consegna - Forte capacità di guidare discussioni sull'architettura, influenzare gli stakeholder e favorire l'allineamento tra team senza autorizzazione diretta - Esperienza pratica in impresa repository e strumenti di architettura come Ardoq o soluzioni comparabili - Solide competenze di modellazione, ad esempio usando ArchiMate, e capacità di creare diagrammi architettonici chiari e pronti per la decisione - Solida conoscenza ed esperienza comprovata con Azure e lo stack tecnologico Microsoft, idealmente supportato da certificazioni di livello avanzato come Azure Solution Architect - Esperienza pratica in aree tecniche tra cui cloud, infrastruttura, rete, identità, API e integrazione, e modelli di sicurezza - Forti capacità analitiche e di problem solving, con la capacità di strutturare argomenti complessi e comunicarli chiaramente - Laurea universitaria in informatica aziendale, informatica o campo correlato, o esperienza professionale equivalente - Eccellenti capacità comunicative con competenza in inglese; La competenza del tedesco è un vantaggio

jobs.title: Associate - Corporate Tax (Steuerberatung & Dissertation im Steuerrecht) 60%
jobs.description:
Parallel zur Dissertation im Steuerrecht an der Universität St. Gallen arbeitest du 60% in unserem Corporate Tax-Team bei PwC Schweiz in Zürich. Du berätst Kunden:innen in verschiedenen Steuerangelegenheiten und unterstützt bei ausgewählten Projekten, arbeitest an Aufgabenstellungen im Verfahrens- und Steuerstrafrecht und erhältst wertvolle Einblicke in steuerrechtliche Themen. Dabei profitierst du vom Fachwissen unseres Teams, lernst die zahlreichen Karrierewege bei PwC kennen und entwickelst dich durch regelmässiges Feedback von Kolleg:innen und Vorgesetzten kontinuierlich weiter.

• Berate juristische Personen aus verschiedenen Branchen und Industrien in Steuerbelangen.

• Begleite die Steuerplanung von Unternehmen unserer nationalen und internationalen Kund: innen.

• Arbeite an Aufgabenstellungen im Verfahrens- und Steuerstrafrecht.

• Bearbeite herausfordernde und komplexe steuerliche Anfragen in einem internationalen Umfeld und setze dein Fachwissen ein, um bestmögliche Lösungen zu finden.

• Profitiere von unserem Fachwissen und unserer Erfahrung.

• Lerne die vielfältigen Möglichkeiten und Karrierechancen kennen, die PwC bietet.

• Sei Teil eines inspirierenden Teams und erhalte regelmässig Feedback von Kolleg:innen und Vorgesetzten.

• (Bevorstehender) erfolgreicher Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften (VWL oder BWL) oder Rechtswissenschaften.

• Erfüllung der Promotionsvoraussetzungen der Universität St.Gallen.

• Interessiere dich für Steuerfragen und die Mitarbeit auf nationalen und internationalen Kundenprojekten.

• Bringe dein Flair für rechtliche Fragestellungen sowie für Zahlen und betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge ein und arbeite gerne an der Schnittstelle von Recht und Ökonomie.

• Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

• Idealerweise erste Praxiserfahrung in Form von anspruchsvollen Praktika oder Berufserfahrung.

• Teamfähig, engagiert, neugierig, wissensdurstig und Freude daran, dich weiterzuentwickeln.

jobs.title: Deals Financial Services Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
A career within the Deals Financial Services team with a focus on Strategy & Operations will provide you with the opportunity to help clients achieve maximum value on their deal transactions by solving transformational and other complex challenges. We focus on all operational aspects of a transaction, pre and post completion. We conduct pre deal and confirmatory due diligence, execute large-scale enterprise-wide integrations, and support complex divestitures and separations on a wide range of functional and cross-functional areas. In this context, we pursue and strengthen our capabilities with AI solutions, to provide our client the outstanding services in an efficient manner.

• Being a member of the Deals Financial Services team, focusing on utilizing AI tools to support the Deals and Transformation teams in delivering their services.

• Your primary focus will be on clients in the financial service industry, particularly large insurance companies, collaborating closely with our US network and colleagues.

• Assisting clients in optimizing their legal structures through processes such as legal rationalization and separations.

• Additionally, you will collaborate with our Deals and Advisory services on significant deals and transformations, necessitating experience in managing complex project structures across various regions.

• Contributing to our rapidly expanding deals practice, which is a leading provider of M&A consulting services in Switzerland, leveraging AI-based tools effectively.

• You hold a Master's degree related to business administration or similar.

• You have a minimum of 6 years of relevant work experience, ideally acquired in the industry or at consulting firms like Big4.

• You have a proven track record of successfully utilizing AI-supported tools in previous roles to assist organizations in managing and analyzing extensive datasets.

• Experience in M&A execution related to business integrations and carve-outs in the financial services industry, particularly insurance, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end transaction process.

• You bring project management expertise and the ability to oversee a Project Management Office (PMO) across multiple workstreams and geographies.

jobs.title: Senior Associate – AI & Data Consultant (Tax & Legal innovation)
jobs.description:
Shape the future of AI transformation

We are a team of Tax and Legal technology experts and enthusiasts dedicated to transforming and disrupting. Our mission is to design, build, and scale AI solutions that redefine how legal, compliance, and tax services are delivered. Combining deep technical expertise in machine learning and artificial intelligence with a sharp focus on market needs, we transform research insights into innovative, practical solutions that deliver real-world impact. You will collaborate closely with tax and legal professionals as well as technologists in an international, multidisciplinary environment to deliver practical, business-driven AI solutions.

• Acting as a trusted advisor to clients within the Tax and Legal domain, supporting them from strategy definition through to implementation with a strong focus on applied AI solutions

• Collaborating with tax and legal professionals to drive digital transformation, including automating processes, extracting insights from documents and transactions, and developing AI-powered tools

• Designing and implementing applied AI solutions for Tax and Legal, such as analytics, machine learning models, and generative AI applications that deliver measurable business value

• Working with clients to define data and AI strategies for tax and legal functions, translating business and regulatory requirements into scalable technical solutions

• Modernising client data landscapes using state-of-the-art data architectures, cloud-enabled platforms, and best-practice implementation approaches

• Developing self-service analytics and visualisation solutions that enable tax and legal stakeholders to generate actionable insights

• Identifying and shaping business development opportunities in the Tax and Legal AI space by assessing current technology landscapes and emerging trends

• Acting as a data and AI ambassador within PwC, promoting the adoption of modern technologies and applied AI capabilities across the Tax and Legal practice

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Natural Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics, or a comparable technical field

• At least three years of experience delivering or implementing applied AI or data solutions, ideally in a consulting, product, or research environment

• Practical expertise in applied AI within Tax and Legal, such as generative or non-generative AI, legal tech, tax tech, analytics engineering, or data management

• Strong programming or scripting skills in Python or a comparable language such as TypeScript, JavaScript, or Bash

• Hands-on experience with machine learning, large language models, data engineering, or end-to-end AI solution development

• Strong business acumen with the ability to translate tax and legal requirements into scalable, value-driven technology solutions

• Experience in client-facing roles, ideally within consulting or professional services, with confidence engaging business and technical stakeholders

• Excellent communication skills in German and English, enabling clear explanation of complex AI and data topics to tax, legal, and business audiences

La nostra missione è progettare, costruire e scalare soluzioni AI che ridefiniscano il modo in cui vengono forniti i servizi legali, di conformità e fiscali. Combinando una profonda esperienza tecnica nell'apprendimento automatico e nell'intelligenza artificiale con una forte attenzione alle esigenze del mercato, trasformiamo le conoscenze della ricerca in soluzioni pratiche e innovative che offrono un impatto nel mondo reale. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con professionisti fiscali e legali, nonché con tecnologi in un ambiente internazionale e multidisciplinare per fornire soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale pratiche e orientate al business. ## Mansioni - Agire come consulente di fiducia per i clienti nel settore fiscale e legale, supportandoli dalla definizione della strategia fino all'implementazione con una forte attenzione alle soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale applicata - Collaborare con professionisti fiscali e legali per guidare la trasformazione digitale, inclusa l'automazione dei processi, l'estrazione di informazioni da documenti e transazioni e lo sviluppo di strumenti basati sull'intelligenza artificiale - Progettare e implementare soluzioni di intelligenza artificiale applicate per il settore fiscale e legale, come analisi, modelli di machine learning e applicazioni di intelligenza artificiale generativa che forniscono valore aziendale misurabile - Collaborare con i clienti per definire dati e strategie di intelligenza artificiale per questioni fiscali e legali funzioni legali, traducendo i requisiti aziendali e normativi in soluzioni tecniche scalabili - Modernizzazione del panorama dei dati dei clienti utilizzando architetture di dati all'avanguardia, piattaforme abilitate per il cloud e approcci di implementazione delle migliori pratiche - Sviluppo di soluzioni di analisi e visualizzazione self-service che consentano alle parti interessate fiscali e legali di generare informazioni utili - Identificazione e definizione di opportunità di sviluppo aziendale nello spazio dell'IA fiscale e legale valutando gli attuali panorami tecnologici e le tendenze emergenti - Agire come ambasciatore dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale all'interno di PwC, promuovendo l'adozione di tecnologie moderne e capacità di intelligenza artificiale applicata nella pratica fiscale e legale ##

Nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec nos client·e·s pour veiller à ce qu'ils·elles respectent leurs obligations en matière de conformité tout en gérant efficacement les risques et en améliorant la transparence. ## Mansioni - Etablir des déclarations fiscales pour les personnes morales et physiques. - Apprendre et développer des mécanismes liés à la fiscalité. - Evoluer dans un environnement axé sur le travail d'équipe, la confiance et l'entraide. ##

jobs.title: Manager & Senior Manager in Life Sciences Quality Management Consulting
jobs.description:
• Help sell, lead and, together with the team, deliver high-impact projects engaging with senior stakeholders from high-profile clients in the life sciences industry.

• Help develop new ideas and propositions to share with clients to secure new and expand existing projects. Projects typically include the design and implementation of new technologies, quality systems processes, operating models, digital strategies and ways of working across R&D, manufacturing / supply chain and commercial. This includes driving business performance through changing quality culture / mind-sets, improving processes and procedures, benefitting from process automation and enabling insights from advanced analytics and AI. The outcomes we help clients deliver include driving faster development, manufacturing and commercial timelines, exploiting internal and external data through advanced analytics and machine learning, improving quality and compliance amongst many others.

• The functions covered include all those across R&D, manufacturing and commercial, with particular focus on quality management / assurance, regulatory affairs, product safely and medical affairs. The role will also work closely with our consulting teams covering commercial, market access and other functions across the Life Sciences value chain.

• Work with international clients and we will provide you the opportunity to gain experience working in multi-cultural teams within Switzerland and abroad.

• Be collaborating with PwC's global network of Life Sciences experts, you will have access to our market leading propositions, methodologies, assets and training materials.

• Work in a fast growing team. The environment is driven by respect, collegiality, strong team spirit, winning as team not as an individual.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a science-related discipline plus around 6 years' experience working in life sciences, within R&D, manufacturing or commercial at a life sciences company. Out of the 6 years you have at least 3 years experiences working as a consultant.

• In consulting, you will have experience in working & running large transformation projects, with experience in developing new propositions and developing new work. From industry, you will have been exposed to many of the key steps of improving quality in regulated business functions.

• Exposure in innovations in technology/cloud/RWD/NLP that drove/could drive business performance, simplification and/or patient centricity in the health industries and markets.

• Exposure to some of the following areas: GxP, data privacy / protection, digital strategy development, operating model design, quality system design / improvement / maintenance, process improvement, technology implementation and digital & analytics technologies in a GxP regulated environment.

• Pay attention to detail, have strong problem-solving skills and are technologically proficient.

• Excellent teamworking, interpersonal, listening and communication skills.

• Fluent in English and ideally have knowledge of German and/or French and you have travel mobility to serve international clients.

• Passionate team player during worktime and enjoy socializing with clients and colleagues after work.

Beschreibung - Helfen Sie zu verkaufen, zu führen und zusammen mit dem Team hocheffiziente Projekte zu liefern, die mit Senior Stakeholdern von hochkarätigen Kunden in der Life Sciences-Branche engagieren. - Helfen Sie, neue Ideen und Vorschläge zu entwickeln, um mit Kunden zu teilen, um neue und bestehende Projekte zu sichern. Les projets comprennent généralement la conception et la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles technologies, des processus de systèmes de qualité, des modèles d'exploitation, des stratégies numériques et des façons de travailler dans les secteurs de la R-D, de la fabrication et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et du commerce. Il s'agit notamment de stimuler la performance de l'entreprise en changeant la culture de la qualité / les ensembles d'esprits, en améliorant les processus et les procédures, en tirant parti de l'automatisation des processus et en permettant d'avoir des idées de l'analyse avancée et de l'IA. Les résultats que nous aidons les clients sont notamment l'accélération du développement, de la fabrication et des délais commerciaux, l'exploitation des données internes et externes par l'analyse avancée et l'apprentissage automatique, l'amélioration de la qualité et de la conformité, entre autres. - Les fonctions couvertes comprennent toutes celles de la R-D, de la fabrication et du commerce, en particulier la gestion et l'assurance de la qualité, les affaires réglementaires, les produits en toute sécurité et les affaires médicales. Le rôle sera également en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes de conseil couvrant les fonctions commerciales, l'accès aux marchés et d'autres fonctions dans toute la chaîne de valeur des Sciences de la vie. - Travailler avec des clients internationaux et nous vous donnerons l'occasion d'acquérir de l'expérience en équipe multiculturelle en Suisse et à l'étranger. - Collaborez avec le réseau mondial d'experts en sciences de la vie de PwC, vous aurez accès à nos propositions, méthodologies, actifs et matériels de formation de pointe. - Travailler dans une équipe en pleine croissance. L'environnement est animé par le respect, la collégialité, l'esprit d'équipe fort, gagnant en équipe pas en tant qu'individu.
• Requisiti - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences et environ 6 ans d'expérience en sciences de la vie, en R-D, en fabrication ou en commerce dans une entreprise de sciences de la vie. - Sur les 6 ans, vous avez au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que consultant. - En consultant, vous aurez de l'expérience dans le travail et la gestion de grands projets de transformation, avec de l'expérience dans le développement de nouvelles propositions et de nouveaux travaux. - De l'industrie, vous aurez été exposé à plusieurs des étapes clés de l'amélioration de la qualité dans les fonctions commerciales réglementées. - L'exposition aux innovations technologiques/cloud/RWD/NLP qui ont entraîné/pourraient stimuler la performance des entreprises, la simplification et/ou la centricité des patients dans les industries et les marchés de la santé. - Exposition à certains des domaines suivants : GxP, confidentialité des données / protection, développement de stratégie numérique, conception de modèles d'exploitation, conception / amélioration / maintenance de systèmes de qualité, amélioration des processus, mise en œuvre technologique et technologies numériques & analytiques dans un environnement réglementé GxP. - Faites attention aux détails, avez de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et sont technologiquement compétents. - Excellent travail d'équipe, interpersonnel, d'écoute et de communication. - Bonne connaissance de l'anglais et de l'allemand et/ou du français et mobilité pour servir les clients internationaux.

jobs.title: Manager and Senior Manager in Life Sciences R&D Management Consulting
jobs.description:
As a Manager / Senior Manager in our fast growing Life Sciences R&D Consulting team, you will be at the heart of transforming how leading pharma, biotech and medtech organisations discover, develop and deliver therapies to patients. You will:
• Sell, lead and deliver high impact projects – Shape and close new opportunities, then lead diverse teams to deliver complex programmes that improve R&D productivity, accelerate development timelines, enhance quality and compliance, and unlock new value for our clients.

• Develop new ideas and propositions – Identify emerging client needs and industry trends, and turn them into distinctive consulting offerings, thought leadership and market leading solutions that you will take directly to clients.

• Work cross functionally across the value chain – Solve end to end challenges spanning R&D, manufacturing and commercial, helping clients break down silos and design integrated operating models, processes and technologies. Collaborate across borders and disciplines – Work with international clients and teams, partnering closely with PwC's global network of life sciences, digital, data/AI and change specialists to bring the best of PwC to every engagement.

• Shape a high growth practice – Play a key role in building our rapidly expanding team: developing our people, strengthening our culture, and helping to define how we work and what we take to market as we scale.
You'll work on mission critical issues for top tier life sciences companies, while contributing directly to the growth and direction of a dynamic and entrepreneurial practice within PwC.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a science related discipline (e.g. life sciences, chemistry, biomedical engineering, pharmacy or related field)

• At least 6 years' relevant work experience, with a strong track record of delivering results in complex environments

• Minimum 3 years' experience in the consulting industry (mandatory), ideally with exposure to life sciences / healthcare clients

• Fluency in English (written and spoken); additional knowledge of German and/or French is highly desirable

• Willingness and ability to travel to serve international clients as needed

• Experience utilizing AI in both client delivery and as consulting tools

What gives you a competitive edge:

• Experience working with a start up or entrepreneurial mentality – proactive, hands on, and comfortable building from a blank sheet

• High comfort with ambiguity and change, with the ability to adapt quickly and remain effective in uncertain or evolving situations

• Proven ability to manage complexity – across multi workstream projects, diverse stakeholder groups and global organisations

• Agile and intellectually curious mindset, continuously seeking new ways to solve problems, learn new topics and apply innovative approaches

• Good understanding of the clinical development lifecycle and associated functions, such as:
* Portfolio and scenario planning
* Regulatory strategy and submissions
* Pre commercialisation activities (e.g. market access, medical affairs, launch readiness)
* Commercialisation activities (e.g. go to market strategy, brand planning, lifecycle management)

• Demonstrated experience in sales and business development, including identifying opportunities, contributing to proposals and pitches, and building long term client relationships

jobs.title: Senior Associate / Manager in SAP Supply Chain Operations Consulting
jobs.description:
• Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kunden an deren Supply-Chain-Prozessen, stellst die SAP Standard Prozesse vor und führst fit to standard Workshops durch. Dabei definierst du die optimalste Lösung für unsere Kunden.

• Unterstütze unsere Kunden bei der Integration moderner Technologien wie IoT oder Predictive Analytics in ihre S/4HANA-Lösungen.

• Du leitest je nach Rolle ein kleines Team von Beratern in anspruchsvollen und dynamischen SAP-Transformationsprogrammen.

• Du teilst dein Wissen im Team und erweiterst deine Fähigkeiten durch gezielte Schulungen im Rahmen deines persönlichen Entwicklungsplans.

• Werde Teil eines wachsenden, dynamischen Teams, das SAP-Innovationen mit Branchenexpertise verbindet und entfalte dich in einem Umfeld, dass auf Teamarbeit, Vertrauen und gegenseitige Unterstützung setzt.

• Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor/Master/Diplom) in Betriebswirtschaft, IT, Ingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer digitalen Disziplin.

• Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Prozessberatung und Implementierung von SAP-Lösungen, idealerweise mit fundierter Expertise in SAP-Supply-Chain- und Logistikmodulen sowie einem tiefen Verständnis der zugehörigen Geschäftsprozesse.

• Das Erstellen von funktionalen Designs ist kein Fremdwort für dich und du bringst Erfahrung im SAP Customizing mit.

• Eine innovative Denkweise; Erfahrungen mit GenAI und Cloud-Technologien sind von Vorteil.

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, eine „Can-Do“-Einstellung sowie fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

• Flexibilität für Einsätze in anderen Regionen der Schweiz und/oder im Ausland sowie eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis.

jobs.title: Senior Manager/Director in SAP Supply Chain Operations Consulting
jobs.description:
• Work with our clients on their supply chain operations processes, evaluate the best use of SAP solutions in Fit to Standard workshops and advise them on design and implementation of best-in-class SAP solutions.

• Help and support our clients to integrate solutions based on the latest technology such as IoT or predictive analytics with their S/4HANA solution.

• You Manage sub-teams, project work streams or transformation programs in challenging and fast paced environments.

• Contribute to the development of our world-class SAP consulting team and expand your capabilities through specific training following your personal development plan.

• Be part of a growing, dynamic team blending SAP innovation and industry expertise and thrive in an environment committed to teamwork, trust and mutual support.

• Be coached by inspiring and challenging leaders.

• A degree (bachelor / master / diploma) preferred in business, IT, engineering, business information systems or a digital discipline.

• More than 8 years of experience in process consulting and implementation of SAP solutions with relevant experience in SAP supply chain and logistics modules and a profound understanding of the related business processes.

• You are familiar with SAP Activate and agile- as well as classic project management methodologies

• As Senior Manger you have lead smaller teams of min 10 people.

• As Director you lead at least one transformation program.

• Team player and ready to take on responsibility on projects and to foster innovative solutions.

• Relevant leadership experience which includes coaching, managing engagement teams and client relation management.

• You are able to drive RFPs to generate new business

• Innovative mindset and previous exposure to GenAI and Cloud is advantageous.

• Strong analytical skills with a “can do" attitude, fluent in English and German.

• Flexible to work on engagements in other parts of Switzerland and/or abroad and a valid work permit.
