jobs.title: Senior Manager/ Director - Beratung Gesundheitswesen mit Fokus Krankenversicherung
jobs.description:
Als eines der weltweit führenden Professional-Services-Unternehmen bietet PwC eine breite Palette von Beratungsleistungen in verschiedenen Branchen an und hilft Unternehmen, komplexe Herausforderungen zu meistern und ihre strategischen Ziele zu erreichen. Wir arbeiten eng mit unseren Kund:innen zusammen, um ihnen massgeschneiderte Lösungen für ihre spezifischen Bedürfnisse zu bieten, sei es bei der Entwicklung innovativer Strategien, der Verbesserung der betrieblichen Effizienz oder der Nutzung neuer Technologien.

• Entwickle qualitativ hochstehende Lösungen für unsere Kund:innen im Gesundheitswesen mit Fokus auf Leistungserbringer und Krankenversicherungen.

• Entwickle unsere Angebotsschwerpunkte weiter aus und unterstütze deine Kund:innen bei komplexen strategischen Fragestellungen und im Bereich Organisationsentwicklung, entwickele optimale Prozesse im Rahmen von Operational Excellence, arbeite an der Digitalisierung im Krankenversicherungsumfeld, treibe die Finanzfunktion weiter oder gestalte die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens und der Versorgungslandschaft mit eigenen Initiativen mit.

• Du kennst dich aus mit den aktuellen Herausforderungen im Spitalbereich und kannst komplexe Programme für Krankenversicherer, erarbeiten und gemeinsam mit den Kund:innen implementieren und begleiten.

• Bringe dich in die neuen Trends der Branche ein wie z.B. Value Based Healthcare oder Integrierte Versorgungsmodelle und entwickle und treibe mit den Kund:innen in Workshops innovative und neuartige Business Modelle boran.

• Wirke mit in einem erstklassigen Beratungsteam mit Fokus auf Krankenversicherungen, Gesundheitswesen und Spitäler,

• Erweitere dein bestehendes Kundenportfolio, welches du aktiv ausbaust und bereits Projekte darüber generierst.

• Trage zum Ausbau unserer Kundenbeziehungen im schweizerischen Gesundheitswesen sowie zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots bei.

• Bringe ein eigenes Netzwerk in der Krankenversicherungsbranche ein und du übernimmst selbstständig Aufgaben in der Akquise von Projekten.

• Universitäts- oder ETH-Abschluss (vorzugsweise Wirtschaft oder Medizin mit betriebswirtschaftlicher Weiterbildung) und über mindestens 10 Jahre relevante Berufspraxis im Gesundheitswesen, davon mind. 5 Jahre in der Beratung oder interner Unternehmensentwicklung im Bereich Krankenversicherungen

• Dank deiner raschen Auffassungsgabe kannst du Zahlen, Statistiken und Marktanalysen rasch verstehen, analysieren und die richtigen Schlüsse ziehen.

• Belegter Leistungsnachweis für die erfolgreiche Leitung und Umsetzung von komplexen Projekten, im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen.

• Bestehendes Kundenportfolio, über welches du eigenständig Projekte akquirieren kannst.

• Einschlägige Kenntnisse des schweizerischen Gesundheitswesens und der aktuellen Trends in dieser Branche. Dein überzeugendes Auftreten macht dich zu einem/einer kompetenten Gesprächspartner:in für unsere Kund:innen.

• Gute Kenntnisse der neuen technologischen Entwicklungen/Trends (z.B. KI) oder Bereitschaft, das notwendige Wissen schnell anzueignen.

• Hoch motivierte und dynamische Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem strategischem Denkvermögen und ausgeprägter Sozialkompetenz.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Französisch ist von Vorteil.

jobs.title: Audit - (Senior) Manager - Trade, Industries & Services - US GAAP
jobs.description:
Ready to take the next step in your career and make an impact in financial audit? As a (Senior) Manager in our Financial Audit team, you'll join skilled professionals passionate about excellence and innovation. You'll lead and mentor teams in a dynamic, international environment, combining technical expertise with leadership skills. This role offers the chance to work with diverse clients, tackle complex audits, and shape the future of financial reporting. Together with your team, you'll create value, inspire trust, and drive meaningful change. If you're ready to grow as a leader, we want to hear from you.

• Audit Expertise: You will audit clients in the Trade, Industries & Services area.

• Integrated Audits: You are responsible for integrated audits of companies that prepare financial statements in accordance with United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP) and file with the Securities Exchange Commission (SEC).

• Statutory Audits: You are responsible for statutory audits of companies that prepare financial statements in accordance with Swiss law.

• Deliver Results: You are responsible for the preparation of the audit file for Partner review and assisting in the presentation of the audit findings to management or the Board of Directors.

• Client Relationships: You develop new and extend existing relationships with our clients and actively support the client in technical accounting matters.

• Own Your Development: You are in the driver's seat of your own responsibility, flexibility, and development.

• Experience: You have more than 5+ years of demonstrable experience in a similar role at a Big 4 company and/or at least the equivalent to 5 'busy-seasons' of experience in auditing with large multinational clients.

• Technical Expertise: You are technically strong with an excellent working knowledge of US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, SOX, and PCAOB standards.

• Certification: You hold a US CPA qualification or an equivalent certification.

• Audit Management: You have experience in managing large, multi-location audits and are highly effective in your day-to-day management of clients and network PwC firms within the region.

• Relationship Building: You have experience in building and maintaining strong relationships with senior management at local, regional, and corporate levels.

• Team Player: You are a team player with the ability to report upwards to Partners.

• Communication Skills: You have excellent English verbal and written communication skills - German is a plus.

jobs.description:
Im Bereich Unternehmenssteuern geht es nicht nur darum, Unternehmen bei der Einhaltung von Vorschriften zu unterstützen. Wir beraten national oder international tätige Unternehmen auch im Hinblick auf die relevanten Steuervorschriften und -entwicklungen. So können sie effiziente Strukturen aufbauen, die steuerlichen Auswirkungen möglicher Geschäftsmodelle berücksichtigen und Steuerrisiken vermeiden.
Als wertvolles Teammitglied berätst du Kund:innen (sowohl Unternehmen als auch Privatpersonen) in verschiedenen Steuerangelegenheiten und wirkst bei der Verwaltung anspruchsvoller Projekte mit.

• Interessiere dich für Steuerfragen und habe bereits erste Erfahrungen im Bereich der Unternehmenssteuern/Steuern gesammelt.

jobs.title: Manager - Transfer Pricing (Financial Services) 80 – 100%
jobs.description:
The Transfer Pricing Manager will manage and coordinate multi-country transfer pricing projects for multinational groups within the Financial Services sector. This role involves designing and optimizing business models, implementing global strategies, and advising clients on transfer pricing policies, governance, and dispute resolution. You will work closely with senior stakeholders and lead complex projects across jurisdictions.

• Manage, direct, and coordinate multi-country transfer pricing projects for multinational groups.

• Develop concepts for new business models or optimize existing ones, and oversee global implementation.

• Scope, plan, and deliver solutions for leading companies across diverse industries.

• Review and assess global value chains and business models (flows of products, services, IP) to identify client needs and develop tailored solutions.

• Advise clients on setting and defending transfer pricing policies, governance, documentation, and technology solutions.

• Support dispute resolution assignments and negotiate advance rulings with tax authorities.

• Contribute to business development by winning work and developing service offerings.

• Collaborate with internal teams and leverage the global transfer pricing network to deliver impactful solutions.

• Provide training and guidance to stakeholders on transfer pricing principles.

• Master's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Law, or equivalent.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in Transfer Pricing, in a consultancy or Financial Services environment.

• Proven experience managing and coordinating multi-country transfer pricing projects.

• Strong knowledge of OECD guidelines and local tax regulations.

• Fluent in English; proficiency in German is strongly preferred, French would also be a big plus.

• Excellent analytical skills and ability to work with data, conduct research, and draft industry analyses.

• Advanced MS Office skills, particularly Excel; experience with TP software is a plus.

• Leadership capability and willingness to take responsibility for teams or areas of expertise.

• Result-oriented mindset with adaptability and persistence in complex situations.

• Sviluppare concetti per nuovi modelli di business o ottimizzare quelli esistenti e supervisionare l'implementazione globale.

• Verificare e valutare catene di valore globali e modelli di business (flusso di prodotti, servizi, IP) per identificare le esigenze del cliente e sviluppare soluzioni su misura.
• Consigliare i clienti alla definizione e alla difesa delle politiche sui prezzi di trasferimento, della governance, della documentazione e delle soluzioni tecnologiche.
• Sostenere gli incarichi di risoluzione delle controversie e negoziare le decisioni di anticipo con le autorità fiscali.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo aziendale vincendo il lavoro e sviluppando offerte di servizi.
• Collaborare con i team interni e sfruttare la rete globale di prezzi di trasferimento per fornire soluzioni efficaci.
• Fornire formazione e orientamento alle parti interessate sui principi del trasferimento dei prezzi.
• Laurea magistrale in economia, economia, finanza, diritto o equivalente.

jobs.title: Manager - Risk Consulting (Trade, Industry and non-financial Services)
jobs.description:
You will join our Risk Consulting and Forensics team at PwC Switzerland, where we help clients in Trade, Industry and non-financial Services (TIS) strengthen governance, risk management, internal controls and compliance frameworks. Working at the intersection of regulation and business, you and your colleagues support organisations in navigating complex regulatory landscapes, enhancing internal controls, and managing investigations or forensic projects. You will collaborate in a diverse, cross-functional and international environment that values learning, innovation and practical impact.

• Lead and manage transformative internal controls projects from strategy through execution, including SOX, design, implementation, testing, remediation and reporting to senior management.

• Deliver high-quality, data-driven internal audit engagements, from risk-based planning through execution to clear reporting of findings and recommendations.

• Guide and coach a team of consultants in a dynamic environment, ensuring high-quality delivery, professional growth and an inclusive team culture.

• Cultivate and expand strong client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and fostering long-term partnerships across TIS industries.

• Drive business development by identifying opportunities, preparing compelling proposals and leading client presentations.

• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of internal methodologies, tools and best practices.

• University degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Information Technology or related field.

• CPA, CIA, or other relevant certifications (e.g., CISA) preferred.

• 5+ years of professional experience in internal controls, internal audit, or risk management, preferably in consulting, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role.

• In-depth knowledge of auditing standards, SOX requirements, financial reporting, internal control frameworks (e.g., COSO), internal audit, and best practices.

• Solid track record of project and client management showing the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication skills in English. German is a big plus.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify key issues and provide effective solutions.

• Client-oriented, flexible, hands-on, team player, willing to develop professionally and personally.

• Experience in leveraging data analytics tools is a plus.

• Familiarity with Internal Control software, internal audit tools, or GRC platforms is a plus.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager - Digitale Transformation (Public Sector Strategy & Transformation)
jobs.description:
• Gestalte die digitale Transformation des öffentlichen Sektors an der Schnittstelle von Politik, Management und Technologie – indem du Entscheidungsträger dabei unterstützt, zukunftsgerichtete Strategien zu erarbeiten, Organisationen weiterzuentwickeln und den Einsatz neuer Technologien wirkungsvoll zu steuern.

• Übernimm Verantwortung für die Akquisition und Leitung von Projekten und entwickle gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden innovative Lösungen für die Verwaltung und den Service public im digitalen Zeitalter.

• Denke unternehmerisch, erkenne frühzeitig Trends und Chancen und trage aktiv zum Ausbau unserer Kundenbeziehungen sowie zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Leistungsportfolios bei.

• Sei Teil eines engagierten Public-Sector-Teams, übernimm Führungsverantwortung und fördere gezielt die Entwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden sowie deine eigene.

• Ausbildung: Hochschulabschluss (Universität/ETH), Fachrichtung frei wählbar; Weiterbildungen und Zertifikate wie HERMES Advanced und TOGAF von Vorteil.

• Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in der Strategieberatung oder in einer vergleichbaren Stabsfunktion, mit Fokus auf Strategie-, Organisationsentwicklung und digitale Transformation im öffentlichen Sektor (Behörden, staatsnahe Betriebe u.Ä.).

• Netzwerk: Etabliertes und aktives Netzwerk im öffentlichen Sektor in der Schweiz.

• Politik & Technologie: Fundiertes Verständnis politischer Prozesse sowie aktueller technologischer Entwicklungen und deren Auswirkungen auf die öffentiche Hand.

• Kommunikation: Überzeugende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch (mündlich und schriftlich); Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

• Analytik: Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Fragestellungen schnell zu durchdringen und in umsetzbare Lösungen zu überführen.

• Persönlichkeit: Hohe Eigeninitiative, unternehmerisches Denken, starke Teamorientierung und ausgeprägte Lernbereitschaft.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Project Manager
jobs.description:
• Shape and manage strategic project portfolios to align with business objectives and drive measurable results.

• Take care of the portfolio management tool and establish, oversee and further develop our strategic project management framework at both the firm and Line of Service (LoS) levels to ensure consistent execution and prioritization of investments.

• Define and implement clear roles and responsibilities across projects to enhance accountability and governance, driving successful transformation initiatives.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and execute project plans, fostering a culture of teamwork and shared success.

• Contribute to the development and execution of strategic initiatives, ensuring that all projects are aligned with the firm's strategic objectives.

• Prepare reports and presentations to communicate project status, costs, risks and financial impacts across the firm to senior leadership.

• Work with entrepreneurial passion to advance PwC with your contributions

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance or related field.

• 5-7 years of relevant work experience in strategic project portfolio management, ideally within a consulting environment (e.g. internal strategy department, inhouse consulting)

• Proven ability to align projects with strategic goals and deliver measurable business outcomes.

• Expertise in data analysis, target operating models, resource allocation, and financial impact assessment, with experience in reporting to senior stakeholders.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to document and communicate complex strategic plans, project portfolios, and role responsibilities.

• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams, with a focus on driving alignment and accountability.

• Fluent communication and facilitation skills in English and German is a must.

• Experience in project management tools and methodologies.

• Strong problem-solving abilities and a result-oriented mindset.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager – Operations & Manufacturing (Strategy & Transformation) 80-100%
jobs.description:
You will join our dynamic Supply Chain & Operations (SC&O) team within PwC Switzerland's Operations Transformation practice. We support leading companies across industries – incl. Pharma & Life Sciences, Industrial Manufacturing, and Consumer Goods – on high impact strategy and transformation programs spanning manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and broader operations. You will collaborate closely with our PwC and Strategy& global network in an inclusive, entrepreneurial, and high performing environment.

As a (Senior) Manager, you will contribute to and lead key elements of Operations and Manufacturing transformation projects. You will help shape strategies, design transformation programs, and drive implementation together with clients.
Your core responsibilities include:
• Advise clients on Operations Strategy topics, with an emphasis on Manufacturing (e.g., Fit-for-Growth, Make-or-Buy, CDMO Strategy and Ecosystems, Smart/AI Manufacturing, Digital plants, Asset efficiency, Operational Excellence), while also contributing to broader areas such as network strategy and sustainability.

• Lead project workstreams, including problem-solving, data analysis, solution design, and development of high-impact client deliverables.

• Engage directly with client stakeholders, supporting or facilitating workshops, presentations, and discussions.

• Guide junior colleagues in producing high quality analyses and outputs.

• Support business development, including proposal support, preparation of pitch materials, and identification of followon opportunities.

• Contribute to thought leadership on topics such as manufacturing transformation, digital operations, and operational excellence.

• Collaborate with cross-functional PwC and Strategy& experts to bring the best global capabilities to our clients.

• Work in a fast-paced growing environment, driven by respect, camaraderie, and strong team spirit.

We are looking for driven, curious, and collaborative individuals with a passion for solving complex operational challenges.
• Master's degree in business, engineering, or a related discipline from a reputable institution.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in management or strategy consulting, industrial operations, manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, or other operations related fields.

• Proven experience contributing to (or leading) workstreams, structuring analyses, and delivering high quality client outputs.

• Strong analytical and conceptual problem solving skills.

• Significant experience in AI tools for research, slide generation and any other core consulting skill

• Ideally experience in applying AI in a manufacturing environment at client

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence in client facing settings.

• Ability to work in fast-paced environments and manage multiple priorities.

• Collaborative team player with strong ownership and initiative.

• Fluency in English required; German or French is an advantage.

• Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).

• Strong sense of responsibility and independence.

• Flexibility to travel and work on client site when needed.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Digital Assurance, IT Audit and Process Analytics (Financial Services)
jobs.description:
• Analysiere IT- und Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden hinsichtlich IT-Risiken, regulatorischer Vorgaben und bewährter Methoden – und unterstütze sie dabei, ihre Systemlandschaft und deren Einfluss auf die Prozesseffizienz besser zu verstehen.

• Identifiziere Schwachstellen im internen Kontrollsystem, beurteile komplexe Sachverhalte kritisch, entwickle fundierte Erkenntnisse und schlage gezielte Massnahmen zur Risikominimierung vor.

• Prüfe Aufbewahrungssysteme für Digital Assets bei institutionellen Verwahrern und validiere Transaktionen sowie Bestände auf unterschiedlichen Blockchains.

• Bewerte vielfältige Themengebiete wie nicht-finanzielle Berichterstattung (ESG), Cloud Governance und neue Technologien – darunter künstliche Intelligenz.

• Gestalte moderne Jahresabschlussprüfungen aktiv mit – durch den Einsatz digitaler Werkzeuge, Automatisierung, Datenanalysen und innovativer Methoden wie Python oder KI-gestützte Ansätze.

• Entwickle deine Fähigkeiten, dein Netzwerk und dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein - branchenübergreifend, in einem vielfältigen internationalen Team und mit kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung.

• Analytisches und vernetztes Denken: Fähigkeit, komplexe IT- und Geschäftszusammenhänge zu durchdringen, eigenständig massgeschneiderte Lösungen zu entwickeln und proaktiv auf Kundenbedürfnisse einzugehen.

• Datenkompetenz und Technologieaffinität: Fähigkeit, Daten zu strukturieren, zu visualisieren und in aussagekräftige Dashboards zu überführen – sowie Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse-Tools (z. B. Power BI, Alteryx), Automatisierungslösungen und KI.

• Kommunikationsstärke und Kundenorientierung: klare, adressatengerechte Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch, effektive Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams sowie Fähigkeit, stabile Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen und Erwartungen gezielt zu steuern.

• 2-4 Busy Seasons praktische Erfahrung im IT-Audit, IT-Consulting oder in der Prüfung IT-gestützter Geschäftsprozesse - idealerweise ergänzt durch Kenntnisse im Bereich Digital Assets und Blockchain-Transaktionen.

• Organisationsstärke und Resilienz: Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu managen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und auch in herausfordernden Situationen fokussiert und ausgeglichen zu bleiben.

• Hohe Lernbereitschaft und Offenheit gegenüber neuen Technologien, wechselnden Aufgaben und globaler Zusammenarbeit – sowie Motivation, Weiterbildungen wie die CISA-Zertifizierung anzustreben.

descriptionByLocale.it: Analisi IT e processi aziendali dei nostri clienti in relazione ai rischi IT, alle normative regolatorie e alle migliori pratiche - e supportali nel comprendere meglio la loro infrastruttura IT e il suo impatto sulla efficienza dei processi. Identifica le debolezze nel sistema di controllo interno, valuta situazioni complesse in modo critico, sviluppa conclusioni fondate e propone misure mirate per ridurre i rischi. Verifica i sistemi di archiviazione per asset digitali presso depositari istituzionali e valuta le transazioni e i conti su diverse blockchain. Valuta aree tematiche diverse come la rendicontazione non finanziaria (ESG), la governance cloud e le nuove tecnologie - tra cui l'intelligenza artificiale. Partecipa a moderne revisioni annuali attive - attraverso l'uso di strumenti digitali, l'automazione, l'analisi dei dati e metodi innovativi come Python o approcci sostenuti dall'intelligenza artificiale. Sviluppa le tue competenze, la tua rete e la tua consapevolezza di responsabilità - in modo interdisciplinare, in un team internazionale variegato e con un continuo aggiornamento. Pensiero analitico e connettivo: capacità di penetrare in relazioni complesse IT e aziendali, sviluppare soluzioni personalizzate e reagire proattivamente alle esigenze dei clienti. Competenza dati e affinità tecnologica: capacità di strutturare, visualizzare e trasferire i dati in dashboard significative - nonché esperienza con strumenti di analisi dei dati (ad esempio Power BI, Alteryx), soluzioni di automazione e IA. Forza di comunicazione e orientamento al cliente: comunicazione chiara e mirata ai destinatari in italiano e inglese, collaborazione efficace con team internazionali e capacità di costruire relazioni stabili con i clienti e di gestire le loro aspettative. 2-4 stagioni operative di esperienza pratica nel controllo IT, nel consulenza IT o nella revisione dei processi aziendali IT - preferibilmente completate da conoscenze nel settore degli asset digitali e delle transazioni blockchain. Strenghezza organizzativa e resilienza: capacità di gestire più progetti contemporaneamente, assumersi la responsabilità e rimanere concentrati e equilibrati anche in situazioni sfide. Alta propensione all'apprendimento e apertura verso nuove tecnologie, compiti variabili e collaborazione globale - nonché motivazione a perseguire formazioni come la certificazione CISA.

Organizational strength and resilience: ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, assume responsibility, and remain focused and balanced even in challenging situations. jobs.title: Financial Audit (Assistant) Manager - Trade, Industries & Services
jobs.description:
En matière d'audit, nous fournissons l'assurance indépendante et objective que les dossiers, les états et les processus financiers sont exacts, fiables et conformes, afin d'instaurer la confiance des parties prenantes. Nous contribuons donc à l'intégrité des systèmes financiers, facilitons la prise de décision en connaissance de cause, protégeons contre la fraude et promouvons la confiance dans l'environnement des entreprises.

• Être en charge des mandats des clients locaux, nationaux et internationaux actifs dans les domaines du commerce, de l'industrie et des services.

• Superviser la mise en œuvre des missions d'audit ainsi que la rédaction des rapports et des recommandations.

• Acquérir une connaissance approfondie d'un large éventail de clients.

• Diriger une équipe et piloter divers projets.

• Partager activement son expertise et son expérience en enseignant, en coachant et en devenant mentor pour les autres.

• Rejoindre une équipe active et diversifiée dans un secteur en plein développement.

• Améliorer ses compétences dans la gestion de plusieurs parties prenantes et avoir l'opportunité de travailler sur des projets stimulants.

• Justifier de plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire au sein d'un Big Four ou d'une entreprise internationale de second rang.

• Être comptable certifié(e) ou posséder une qualification pertinente (CPA, DEC, ACCA, PJ, etc.).

• Disposer d'une expertise technique extrêmement solide avec une excellente connaissance pratique des réglementations IFRS.

• Maîtriser le français et l'anglais.

• Faire preuve d'innovation, apprécier le travail en équipe ainsi que les contacts avec les clients.

• Démontrer d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.

Contribuiamo così all'integrità dei sistemi finanziari, facilitando decisioni informate, proteggendo contro le frodi e promuovendo la fiducia nell'ambiente aziendale. ## Mansioni - Gestire i mandati di clienti locali, nazionali e internazionali attivi nei settori del commercio, dell'industria e dei servizi. - Supervisionare l'implementazione delle missioni di audit, nonché la redazione di rapporti e raccomandazioni. - Acquisire una conoscenza approfondita di un'ampia gamma di clienti. - Guidare un team e gestire diversi progetti. - Condividere attivamente la propria esperienza e competenza insegnando, facendo coaching e diventando mentore per gli altri. ##
• Cosa offriamo - Entrare a far parte di un team attivo e diversificato in un settore in pieno sviluppo. - Migliorare le proprie competenze nella gestione di più stakeholder e avere l'opportunità di lavorare su progetti stimolanti. ##
• Requisiti - Oltre 5 anni di esperienza in una posizione simile presso una delle Big Four o un'azienda internazionale di secondo livello. - Essere contabile certificato/a o possedere una qualifica pertinente (CPA, DEC, ACCA, PJ, ecc.). - Disporre di una solida competenza tecnica con un'eccellente conoscenza pratica delle normative IFRS. - Padronanza del francese e dell'inglese. - Essere innovativi, apprezzare il lavoro di squadra e i contatti con i clienti. - Dimostrare eccellenti capacità di analisi e sintesi.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description - In the field of audit, we provide independent and objective assurance that financial records, statements, and processes are accurate, reliable, and compliant, in order to build stakeholder trust. We contribute to the integrity of financial systems, facilitate informed decision-making, protect against fraud, and promote trust in the business environment. ##
• Responsibilities - Manage mandates for local, national, and international clients active in the trade, industry, and services sectors. - Supervise the execution of audit assignments as well as the drafting of reports and recommendations. - Acquire in-depth knowledge of a wide range of clients. - Lead a team and oversee various projects. - Actively share your expertise and experience by teaching, coaching, and mentoring others. ##
• What we offer - Join an active and diverse team in a rapidly developing sector. - Enhance your skills in managing multiple stakeholders and have the opportunity to work on exciting projects. ##
• Requirements - Over 5 years of experience in a similar position within a Big Four or a second-tier international company. - Certified accountant or relevant qualification (CPA, DEC, ACCA, PJ, etc.). - Strong technical expertise with excellent practical knowledge of IFRS regulations. - Proficiency in French and English. - Innovative mindset, team-oriented, and client-focused. - Excellent analytical and synthesis skills.
descriptionByLocale.de:

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager - Strategy Consulting
jobs.description:
Strategy& ist die globale Strategieberatung von PwC. In der Schweiz unterstützen wir vor allem führende Schweizer Unternehmen dabei, ihre internationale Präsenz zu gestalten – von der Strategie am Hauptsitz bis zur Transformation globaler Geschäftsbereiche. Wir entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Strategien für führende Unternehmen auf Basis klar differenzierender Wettbewerbsvorteile.

Unser Team zeichnet sich durch besonders engen Zusammenhalt aus: von Office Events an spannenden Locations über regelmässige Team Dinner und Team Building Events – bei uns kommt der Spass an der Arbeit nicht zu kurz.

Als Manager:in im Strategy & Transformation Team arbeitest du mit führenden nationalen und internationalen Organisationen verschiedener Branchen zusammen. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du Strategien und Konzepte entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette – von Geschäfts- und Betriebsmodellen über Technologie- und Digitalstrategien bis hin zu Transformationsprogrammen.

Du leitest (Teil-)Projekte, steuerst interdisziplinäre Teams und fungierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Kund:innen, Partner:innen und internen Stakeholdern. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kolleg:innen aus verschiedenen Beratungsbereichen zusammen und nutzt die Expertise unseres globalen Netzwerks, um ganzheitliche Lösungen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen.

Zudem übernimmst du eine Mentor:innenrolle, förderst die Entwicklung deiner Kolleg:innen und trägst aktiv zu einer offenen, kollaborativen Teamkultur bei. Durch Trainings vertiefst du kontinuierlich deine Methoden-, Leadership- und Branchenkompetenz.

In Projekten analysierst du komplexe Fragestellungen unserer Kund:innen, strukturierst Probleme und entwickelst strategische Lösungen mit nachhaltigem Mehrwert. Typische Themen sind:
• Entwicklung von Unternehmens-, Geschäftsbereichs- und Digitalstrategien

• Neugestaltung von Business- und Operating-Modellen

• Planung und Umsetzung von Transformations- und Change-Programmen

• Unterstützung bei M&A-Initiativen, Carve-Outs und Portfoliostrategien

• Optimierung von Organisationen, Prozessen und Wertschöpfungsketten

• Einsatz von Daten, Analytics und neuen Technologien zur Entscheidungsunterstützung

Du trägst Ergebnisverantwortung für deine Projekte, stellst Qualität sowie Budget- und Termintreue sicher und präsentierst Ergebnisse auf C-Level. Darüber hinaus unterstützt du aktiv bei der Akquisition neuer Projekte, entwickelst Angebote und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter aus.

• Akademischer Hintergrund: Überdurchschnittlich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Master, MBA oder PhD) in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, Natur- oder Sozialwissenschaften, Statistik/Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.

• Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Top-Strategieberatung oder in verantwortungsvollen Unternehmensfunktionen, idealerweise mit Fokus auf Strategie, Transformation, Digitalisierung oder Performance Improvement. Erfahrung in der Leitung von Projekten sowie in Angebotsentwicklung und Projektakquisition.

• Internationale Erfahrung: Auslandserfahrung durch Studium oder Beruf und sichere Bewegung in internationalen und interkulturellen Kontexten.

• Kommunikationsstärke: Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch. Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte klar aufzubereiten und überzeugend vor Entscheidungs- und Führungsgremien zu präsentieren.

• Analytische Kompetenz: Stark ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte schnell zu erfassen und in umsetzbare Empfehlungen zu überführen.

• Digitale Affinität: Sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Tools (z. B. Excel, PowerPoint) sowie offen für moderne Datenanalyse- und AI-Tools; Kenntnisse in Datenverarbeitung, Statistiksoftware oder Programmiersprachen sind von Vorteil.

• Persönliches Profil: Hohe Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Teamorientierung. Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Anspruch, nachhaltige Wirkung bei Kund:innen zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Strategy& è la consulenza strategica globale di PwC. In Svizzera, sosteniamo principalmente le aziende svizzere nella definizione della loro presenza internazionale – dalla strategia della sede centrale alla trasformazione delle aree commerciali globali. Sviluppiamo strategie su misura per aziende leader basate su chiaramente differenziando i vantaggi competitivi. Il nostro team è caratterizzato da una coesione particolarmente ravvicinata: dagli eventi di ufficio alle emozionanti location attraverso la cena di squadra regolare e gli eventi di team building – il divertimento al lavoro non è troppo breve. ## Mansioni - # Come manager: nel Team Strategy & Transformation lavori con le principali organizzazioni nazionali e internazionali di diverse industrie. - No. Insieme al vostro team, sviluppate strategie e concetti lungo l'intera catena del valore – dai modelli aziendali e operativi alle strategie tecnologiche e digitali ai programmi di trasformazione. - Lei conduce progetti (partiali), controlla i team interdisciplinari e funge da interfaccia tra clienti, partner: all'interno e agli stakeholder interni. - No. Lavori a stretto contatto con colleghi di diverse aree di consulenza e utilizzi le competenze della nostra rete globale per sviluppare e implementare soluzioni olistiche. - No. Inoltre, si prende un mentore: in-house, promuovere lo sviluppo dei vostri colleghi e contribuire attivamente a una cultura del team aperta e collaborativa. - Attraverso la formazione si approfondisce continuamente il metodo, la leadership e le competenze del settore. - No. Nei progetti, si analizzano questioni complesse dei nostri clienti: all'interno, strutturando i problemi e sviluppando soluzioni strategiche con un valore aggiunto sostenibile. - Argomenti tipici sono: - Sviluppo di strategie aziendali, aziendali e digitali - Riprogettazione di modelli di business e operativi - Pianificazione e realizzazione di programmi di trasformazione e cambiamento - Supporto per iniziative M&A, carve-out e strategie di portafoglio - Ottimizzazione di organizzazioni, processi e catene di valore - Utilizzo di dati, analisi e nuove tecnologie per il supporto decisionale - Sei responsabile dei risultati di bilancio per i tuoi progetti e garantire la qualità. - No. Inoltre, si supporta attivamente l'acquisizione di nuovi progetti, sviluppare offerte e ampliare le relazioni con i clienti esistenti. ##
• Requisiti - Sfondo accademico: diploma universitario superiore alla media (Master, MBA o PhD) in economia, (economico) informatica, (economico)ingegneria, scienze naturali o scienze sociali, statistica/informatica o un'area tematica comparabile. - Esperienza professionale: Esperienza pluriennale in una consulenza strategica superiore o in funzioni aziendali responsabili, idealmente concentrandosi su strategia, trasformazione, digitalizzazione o miglioramento delle prestazioni. Esperienza nella gestione dei progetti e nell'offerta di sviluppo e acquisizione di progetti. - Esperienza internazionale: esperienza all'estero attraverso lo studio o la professione e il movimento sicuro in contesti internazionali e interculturali. - Forza di comunicazione: ottime capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta in tedesco e inglese. Capacità di rendere chiari i contenuti complessi e di presentare in modo convincente prima dei corpi decisionali e di leadership. - Competenza analitica: Forte competenze analitiche e funzionamento strutturato con la capacità di catturare rapidamente situazioni complesse e tradurli in raccomandazioni possibili. - affinità digitale: Sicuro da usare strumenti comuni (ad esempio Excel, PowerPoint) e aperto all'analisi dei dati moderna e agli strumenti AI; La conoscenza dell'elaborazione dei dati, del software statistico o dei linguaggi di programmazione è vantaggiosa. - Profilo personale: Alta iniziativa, senso di responsabilità e orientamento del team. L'orientamento del cliente goffrato e pretendere di ottenere un effetto sostenibile sui clienti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione Strategy& is the global strategy consultancy of PwC. In Switzerland, we mainly support leading Swiss companies in shaping their international presence – from the strategy at the headquarters to the transformation of global business areas. We develop tailor-made strategies for leading companies based on clearly differentiating competitive advantages. Our team is characterized by particularly close cohesion: from office events to exciting locations via regular team dinner and team building events – the fun at work is not too short. ## Mansioni - As a manager:in the Strategy & Transformation Team you work with leading national and international organizations from different industries. - Together with your team, you develop strategies and concepts along the entire value chain – from business and operating models to technology and digital strategies to transformation programs. - You conduct (partial) projects, control interdisciplinary teams and act as an interface between customers, partners: inside and internal stakeholders. - You work closely with colleagues from different consulting areas and use the expertise of our global network to develop and implement holistic solutions. - In addition, you take a mentor: in-house, promote the development of your colleagues and actively contribute to an open, collaborative team culture. - Through training you continuously deepen your method, leadership and industry skills. - In projects, you analyze complex questions of our customers: inside, structuring problems and developing strategic solutions with sustainable added value. - Typical topics are: - Development of corporate, business and digital strategies - Redesign of business and operating models - Planning and implementation of transformation and change programs - Support for M&A initiatives, carve-outs and portfolio strategies - Optimization of organizations, processes and value chains - Use of data, analytics and new technologies for decision support - You are responsible for budget results for your projects and ensure quality. - In addition, you actively support the acquisition of new projects, develop offers and expand existing customer relationships. ##
• Requisiti - Academic background: above-average university degree (Master, MBA or PhD) in economics, (economic) informatics, (economic)engineering, natural sciences or social sciences, statistics/data science or a comparable subject area. - Professional experience: Multiannual experience in a top strategy consulting or in responsible corporate functions, ideally focusing on strategy, transformation, digitization or performance improvement. Experience in managing projects as well as in offering development and project acquisition. - International experience: experience abroad through study or profession and safe movement in international and intercultural contexts. - Communication strength: Very good oral and written communication skills in German and English. Ability to make complex content clear and to present convincingly before decision-making and leadership bodies. - Analytical Competence: Strong Analytical Skills and Structured Operation with the ability to quickly capture complex situations and translate them into feasible recommendations. - Digital affinity: Safe to use common tools (e.g. Excel, PowerPoint) as well as open to modern data analysis and AI tools; Knowledge of data processing, statistical software or programming languages is advantageous. - Personal profile: High initiative, sense of responsibility and team orientation. Embossed customer orientation and claim to achieve a sustainable effect on customers.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager –Technology Strategy & Transformation Consulting
jobs.description:
Our “Technology Strategy & Transformation” team of 40 Management and Technology Consultants in Switzerland spearheads PwC's technology consulting practice. We have the privilege to work with many of the leading companies in the market and new and growing businesses. To best serve our clients in Switzerland and globally, we collaborate closely with our global PwC network. Being part of our high-spirited team provides an exciting, diverse, and inclusive culture.

• Lead and support exciting technology strategy and transformation projects for our clients in various industries.

• Closely work with executives in the technology environment and develop digital strategies as well as effective business models.

• Develop creative, high-quality solutions to current challenges of our clients in the key areas of technology strategy, organization, operating-model, assessment and other related topics.

• Actively involved in the further development of the service offering for Technology Strategy & Transformation Advisory and drive the acquisition of new projects and customers.

• Work in an inspiring team and an international network, receive regular feedback from colleagues and superiors and have access to first-class training in the areas of technical know-how and soft skills.

• Take responsibility for employees in the role of coach and accompany your coachees in their professional and career development.

• A scientific and/or technical background (especially computer science, mathematics, natural sciences and engineering) or in economics and bring 6 to 9 years of experience in leading and supporting strategic technology or transformation projects.

• Preferably, having experience in consulting and bring along methodological and technical skills. Furthermore, you have proven expertise in common methodologies and frameworks (TOGAF, COBIT, SAFe, IPMA, PRINCE, SCRUM, etc.).

• Able to quickly grasp complex scenarios and interrelationships and address them with solution-oriented and entrepreneurial thinking.

jobs.title: IAM Architect
jobs.description:
Are you ready to contribute to the successful delivery of Cyber Technology & Transformation engagements?
This is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing Cyber Technology and Transformation team. We support our clients along the whole cyber security journey, ranging from technology assessments, identification and implementation of cyber solutions, defining cyber strategy and many more. You benefit from a great team to work with and from our broad engagements enabling you to growth personally and professionally.

• Define and implement IAM architecture strategies aligned with business and security objectives of our clients.

• Design scalable and secure identity solutions including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, Customer Identity and access management (CIAM), and privileged access management (PAM).

• Serve as the technical authority for IAM tools and platforms (e.g., Azure AD, ADFS, SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, CyberArk, Forgerock etc.)

• Lead the client project for integration of legacy and modern identity providers into a unified IAM framework

• Develop strong architecture principles and guidelines including scalability, resilience, modularity, and security-by-design

• Lead the deployment and configuration of IAM solutions for clients across cloud and on-premises environments

• Provide IAM integration designs and architectural guidelines for new applications and services, including APIs, SSO, and federation protocols (SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect).

• Conduct review IAM systems for performance, availability, and security

• Drive the adoption of Authentication and Authorization reference architectures for existing, new and emerging IAM technologies

• Develop and enforce IAM policies, standards, and best practices.

• Help our client to achieve compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, SOX, HIPAA) and internal security policies.

• Participate in enterprise architecture governance and contribute to strategic planning.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

• 8+ years of experience in IAM architecture and implementation

• Proven experience with IAM platforms such as SailPoint, ForgeRock, Okta, CyberArk, or similar.

• Strong understanding of directory services (Active Directory, LDAP), PKI, and identity federation.

• Understanding of cloud architectures and strategy (public, private, and hybrid).

• CISSP, CISM, or product vendor certifications is a plus

Technical Skills:
• Expertise in IAM protocols and standards (SAML, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SCIM).

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid identity models.

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture and modern security frameworks.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices is a plus.

Soft Skills:
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

• Ability to work independently and lead cross-functional teams.

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality

jobs.title: Director in Quality & Regulatory Management - Advisory Services
jobs.description:
• Sell, lead and, together with the team, deliver high-impact projects engaging with senior stakeholders from high-profile clients. You will actively drive business development by originating opportunities, leading proposals and converting them into successful client engagements.

• Develop new ideas and propositions to share with clients to secure new and expand existing projects. The projects typically include: (i) Quality and QMS strategy, operating model and target‑state design, (ii) Regulatory strategy and operating model design (e.g. for submissions, registrations, labelling, post‑market / lifecycle management), (iii) Design and implementation of new technologies and ways of working, (iv) Digital strategies and functional roadmaps

• Cover Quality and Regulatory functional expertise across the value chain. You will also work closely with our consulting teams covering commercial, market access, supply chain and other functions.

• Drive the growth and transformation of our Quality and Regulatory team, capabilities and consulting business. You will work closely with PwC's global network of experts and our enterprise AI team to develop and scale new, AI‑enabled propositions, delivery models and assets – both for our clients and for how we operate at PwC.

• Actively build and expand your own network and represent PwC at client meetings, industry events and conferences.

• Work in a fast-growing environment, which is driven by respect, collegiality, and strong team spirit (winning as team, not as an individual).

• You have more than 10 years' experience working within Quality and/or Regulatory, of which at least 6 years in consulting.

• In consulting, you will have worked or are working in a management consulting firm, advising clients on Quality and Regulatory strategy, and you have experience in running large transformation projects and developing new propositions and work.

• In industry roles, you have been exposed to many of the key steps of improving business functions that operate along the value chain.

jobs.title: Manager in Audit Trade, Industries & Services - US GAAP
jobs.description:
Ready to take the next step in your career and make an impact in financial audit? As a Senior Manager in our Financial Audit team, you'll join skilled professionals passionate about excellence and innovation. You'll lead and mentor teams in a dynamic, international environment, combining technical expertise with leadership skills. This role offers the chance to work with diverse clients, tackle complex audits, and shape the future of financial reporting. Together with your team, you'll create value, inspire trust, and drive meaningful change. If you're ready to grow as a leader, we want to hear from you.

• Audit Expertise: You will lead audits for clients in the engineering and manufacturing sector.

• Integrated Audits: You are responsible for integrated audits of companies that prepare financial statements in accordance with United States Generally Accepted . Accounting Principles (US GAAP) and file with the Securities Exchange Commission (SEC).

• Statutory Audits: You are responsible for statutory audits of companies that prepare financial statements in accordance with Swiss law.

• Private Company Audits: You are responsible for audits of private companies that prepare financial statements in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).

• Non-Financial Reporting: You are responsible for managing audits of non-financial reports (e.g., ESG audits).

• Deliver Results: You are responsible for the preparation of the audit file for Partner review and assisting in the presentation of the audit findings to management or the Board of Directors.

• Client Relationships: You develop new and extend existing relationships with our clients and actively support the client in technical accounting matters.

• Own Your Development: You are in the driver's seat of your own responsibility, flexibility, and development.

• Experience: Currently Manager, you have more than 5 years of demonstrable experience in a Big 4 company.

• Technical Expertise: You are technically strong with an excellent working knowledge of US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, SOX, and PCAOB standards.

• Certification: You hold a US CPA qualification or an equivalent certification.

• Audit Management: You have experience in managing large, multi-location audits and are highly effective in your day-to-day management of clients and network PwC firms within the region.

• Relationship Building: You have experience in building and maintaining strong relationships with senior management at local, regional, and corporate levels.

• Team Player: You are a team player with the ability to report upwards to Partners.

• Communication Skills: You have excellent English verbal and written communication skills - French is a plus.

jobs.title: Audit Senior Associate / Assistant Manager - Trade, Industries & Services / US GAAP
jobs.description:
In the field of auditing, we provide independent and objective assurance that records, statements, and financial processes are accurate, reliable, and compliant, in order to instill stakeholder confidence. We therefore contribute to the integrity of financial systems, facilitate informed decision-making, protect against fraud, and promote trust in the business environment.

• Support the engagement manager in planning, executing, and finalizing group and local audits across various non-financial services industries.

• Draft audit reports and recommendations.

• Review the content of mandatory ESG information, including country-specific reports, and provide advice on areas for improvement.

• Acquire in-depth knowledge of a wide range of clients.

• Coordinate a network of international teams on your engagements.

• Join an active and diverse team in a rapidly growing sector.

• A university degree in accounting or a related field, with a US CPA (or a comparable certification) completed or in progress.

• Holder of, or about to obtain, a Chartered Accountant diploma or another similar qualification (DEC, ACCA, etc.).

• 3 to 5 years of recent experience in a public accounting firm, with solid expertise in US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, PCAOB, and SOX.

• Highly motivated and passionate about sustainability, climate-related issues, and associated regulations.

• Fluent in English, French a plus

• Enjoy working in a team and interacting with clients.

• Possess excellent analytical and synthesis skills.

jobs.title: Manager - Cloud, Data & AI (Cloud & Data Platform Architect)
jobs.description:
As a Manager in the Cloud, Data & AI team, you will contribute with your expertise around Microsoft technologies (Azure and Data Platforms), their interplay in ecosystems involving multi-vendor tools and applications (such as Master Data Management, BI, Analytics, AI, etc.) and data architecture knowledge and experience.

• Analyze, design and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of entire systems.

• Consult clients on their data architecture and provide an analysis of efficiency, integration, cost, feasibility and technical dimensions.

• Take ownership of projects, ensuring their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion.

• Partner with team leadership to ensure collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables.

• Continuously develop skills outside your skill set and stay up to date with new technologies and market demand.

• Effectively mentor others, using work reviews as opportunities to deepen team members' expertise.

• Address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members, and other stakeholders, escalating where appropriate.

• Coach and upskill your team mates to ensure the team growth and long-term success

• Solid knowledge and proven experience with Azure and Microsoft technology stack (e.g., Fabric), supported by advanced-level certifications (e.g., Azure Administrator, Solution Architect, Fabric Engineer, etc.).

• Microsoft certification acquired, either AZ-305 or DP-600/DP-700

• Leadership and team development

• Expertise in Azure and Microsoft technologies

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• A university degree in fields such as business informatics, computer science, physics, mathematics, or any engineering discipline is preferred..

• Over 7 years of work experience focusing on data engineering, analytics, or data science, with consulting experience being a plus.

• Experience in sourcing, preparing, and delivering end-to-end data architecture or platform solutions to internal or external clients.

• Excellent communication skills with proficiency in English. German proficiency is preferred, but not required

jobs.title: (Senior) Associate - Transfer Pricing
jobs.description:
• Consult companies from different sectors and industries in transfer pricing issues.

• Review, understand, and assess global value chains and business models of multinational companies (flows of products, services, intellectual property, etc.).

• Conduct challenging and complex functional, financial, and economic analyses for a broad range of industries and create global and country-specific transfer pricing documentation.

• Support with the development of concepts for optimizing existing business models as well as the subsequent implementation of such models on a global basis.

• Be part of an inspiring team, which develops comprehensive concepts and solutions for customers. You will grow in an environment that is characterized by team spirit, trust and mutual support.

• Develop extensive technical know-how and soft skills through on-and-off-the-job training and take on responsibility from day one.

• Master's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Law and Economics, or equivalent.

• Minimum of two years of practical experience in Transfer Pricing either from a consultancy or an industry position.

• Fluent in English. Proficiency in German is a plus.

• Interest and a flair for figures and business contexts, working with data and numbers, conducting research and drafting industry analyses. Curiosity for exploring new possibilities for client problems, seeking new information and driving impact for clients.

• Very good knowledge of MS Office, and of Excel in particular.

• Having a result-oriented mindset and a clear focus on long-term objectives, combined with a willingness to navigate the career path. Equipped with the necessary skills to adapt to complex and challenging situations while remaining flexible and persistent.

jobs.title: Manager SAP Master Data Governance Consulting
jobs.description:
As one of the leading global professional services firms, PwC offers a wide range of consulting services across various industries, helping organisations navigate complex challenges and achieve their strategic goals. We work closely with clients to provide tailored solutions that address their specific needs, whether it's developing innovative strategies, improving operational efficiency, or leveraging emerging technologies.

• Lead and support large-scale projects focusing on S/4HANA or SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) within Switzerland and internationally.

• Collaborate with clients to assess and enhance their master data governance processes, leveraging SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

• Guide clients from the conceptualization of initial ideas through to successful operational implementation, ensuring seamless integration of SAP MDG solutions.

• Design and enhance SAP standard software solutions, tailoring them to meet specific client needs and industry standards.

• Develop custom applications and integrate various software solutions to optimize client operations and data management strategies.

• Bachelor's or master's degree in business, IT, engineering, business information systems, or a related field.

• 3 to 6 years of experience in process consulting and implementation of SAP solutions, with a focus on SAP Master Data Governance and a deep understanding of associated business processes.

• Proven expertise in implementing SAP MDG for Customer, Vendor, Material, or Financial domains, translating business process requirements into technical solutions.

• Experience in process modeling, including entity and business activity changes, workflow design, data replication techniques, and master data conversion.

• Strong analytical skills with practical experience in process analysis and design across various industries.

• Fluency in English and German; additional languages are advantageous.

Gestaltung und Verbesserung von SAP-Standardsoftwarelösungen, angepasst an spezifische Kundenbedürfnisse und Branchenstandards. Entwicklung von kundenspezifischen Anwendungen und Integration verschiedener Softwarelösungen zur Optimierung der Kundenprozesse und Datenmanagementstrategien. Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaft, IT, Ingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Bereich. 3 bis 6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Prozessberatung und Implementierung von SAP-Lösungen, mit Schwerpunkt auf SAP Master Data Governance und einem tiefen Verständnis der damit verbundenen Geschäftsprozesse. Nachgewiesene Expertise bei der Implementierung von SAP MDG für Kunden-, Lieferanten-, Material- oder Finanzbereiche, mit Übersetzung von Geschäftsprozessanforderungen in technische Lösungen. Erfahrung in der Prozessmodellierung, einschließlich Entitäts- und Geschäftsaktivitätsänderungen, Workflow-Design, Datenreplikationstechniken und Stammdatenkonvertierung. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten mit praktischer Erfahrung in der Prozessanalyse und -gestaltung in verschiedenen Branchen. Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse; weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil.
descriptionByLocale.fr: En tant que l'un des principaux cabinets de services professionnels au monde, PwC offre une large gamme de services de conseil dans divers secteurs, aidant les organisations à faire face à des défis complexes et à atteindre leurs objectifs stratégiques. Nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec les clients pour fournir des solutions sur mesure qui répondent à leurs besoins spécifiques, qu'il s'agisse de développer des stratégies innovantes, d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle ou de tirer parti des technologies émergentes. Diriger et soutenir des projets à grande échelle axés sur S/4HANA ou SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) en Suisse et à l'international. Collaborer avec les clients pour évaluer et améliorer leurs processus de gouvernance des données de référence, en exploitant les solutions SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) pour garantir l'exactitude et la cohérence des données. Guider les clients de la conceptualisation des idées initiales jusqu'à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle réussie, en assurant une intégration transparente des solutions SAP MDG. Concevoir et améliorer les solutions logicielles standard SAP, en les adaptant aux besoins spécifiques des clients et aux standards du secteur. Développer des applications personnalisées et intégrer diverses solutions logicielles pour optimiser les opérations des clients et les stratégies de gestion des données. Bachelor ou master en commerce, informatique, ingénierie, systèmes d'information de gestion ou dans un domaine connexe. 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en conseil de processus et en mise en œuvre de solutions SAP, avec un focus sur SAP Master Data Governance et une compréhension approfondie des processus métier associés. Expertise avérée dans la mise en œuvre de SAP MDG pour les domaines Client, Fournisseur, Matériel ou Financier, en traduisant les exigences des processus métier en solutions techniques. Expérience en modélisation de processus, incluant les changements d'entités et d'activités métier, la conception de workflows, les techniques de réplication de données et la conversion des données de référence. Fortes capacités analytiques avec une expérience pratique dans l'analyse et la conception de processus dans divers secteurs. Maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'allemand ; des langues supplémentaires sont avantageuses.

jobs.title: Audit Senior Associate / Assistant Manager - Trade, Industries & Services / US GAAP
jobs.description:
In our Audit - Trade, Industries & Services (TIS) practice, we don't just analyze numbers; we uncover insights that help businesses grow, adapt, and succeed in a rapidly changing world. We work with a diverse range of clients, from global corporations to dynamic local businesses, helping them navigate through challenges, seize opportunities, and build a sustainable future.

By combining our unique perspectives and leveraging advanced technology, we're shaping the future of auditing and the industries we serve. Every project is an opportunity to grow, make an impact, and contribute to building trust in society.

• Take ownership of planning, executing, and completing group and local audits across a variety of non-financial services industries, with a focus on US GAAP and SOX testing.

• Perform SOX internal controls testing in compliance with the latest PCAOB guidance, demonstrating your expertise in internal controls for US-listed groups as well as their significant subsidiaries based in Switzerland.

• Collaborate with international teams and clients, fostering strong relationships and ensuring seamless communication across borders.

• Drive the integration of our remote team members, ensuring they are part of our local engagement team.

• Leverage digital tools, data analysis software, and automation solutions to structure, visualize, and present actionable insights that add value for clients.

• Embrace new challenges and opportunities to grow, developing your leadership skills and contributing to the success of your team and clients.

• A university degree in accounting or a related field, with a US CPA (or a comparable certification) completed or in progress.

• 3-5 years of recent experience in a public accounting firm, with solid expertise in US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, PCAOB, and SOX.

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and develop tailored solutions for clients.

• Proficiency in English; knowledge of German, French, or Italian is an advantage.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams, foster client relationships, and manage expectations.

Why Join Us?
We understand that your career is more than just a job - it's a journey. That's why we're committed to supporting you every step of the way:

• Professional Growth: Access tailored learning opportunities, mentorship, and financial support for further certifications.

• Professional Growth

• Flexibility: Work arrangements that help you balance your professional and personal life.

• Flexibility

• Inclusive Culture: A diverse and collaborative environment where your unique perspective is valued.

• Inclusive Culture

• Innovative Tools: Leverage advanced technology and creative approaches to redefine the future of auditing.

• Innovative Tools

• Purpose-Driven Work: Contribute to meaningful projects that make a difference for our clients, society, and the planet.

• Purpose-Driven WorkReady to make an impact?
Join our community of solvers and help us shape the future of auditing - digital, sustainable, and global. Apply now!

descriptionByLocale.it: Nella nostra practice Audit - Trade, Industries & Services (TIS), non ci limitiamo ad analizzare i numeri; scopriamo intuizioni che aiutano le aziende a crescere, adattarsi e avere successo in un mondo in rapida evoluzione. Lavoriamo con una vasta gamma di clienti, da grandi corporation globali a dinamiche imprese locali, aiutandoli ad affrontare le sfide, cogliere le opportunità e costruire un futuro sostenibile. Combinando le nostre prospettive uniche e sfruttando la tecnologia avanzata, stiamo plasmando il futuro dell'audit e dei settori che serviamo. Ogni progetto è un'opportunità per crescere, fare la differenza e contribuire a costruire fiducia nella società. Assumersi la responsabilità della pianificazione, dell'esecuzione e del completamento degli audit di gruppo e locali in una varietà di settori di servizi non finanziari, con un focus su US GAAP e test SOX. Eseguire il testing dei controlli interni SOX in conformità con le ultime linee guida PCAOB, dimostrando la propria competenza nei controlli interni per i gruppi quotati negli USA e per le loro filiali significative con sede in Svizzera. Collaborare con team internazionali e clienti, favorendo solide relazioni e garantendo una comunicazione fluida oltre confine. Promuovere l'integrazione dei membri remoti del team, assicurandosi che facciano parte del team di incarico locale. Sfruttare strumenti digitali, software di analisi dei dati e soluzioni di automazione per strutturare, visualizzare e presentare informazioni operative che aggiungano valore per i clienti. Abbracciare nuove sfide e opportunità di crescita, sviluppando le proprie capacità di leadership e contribuendo al successo del team e dei clienti. Laurea universitaria in contabilità o in un campo correlato, con US CPA (o certificazione comparabile) completata o in corso. 3-5 anni di recente esperienza in uno studio di contabilità pubblica, con solida competenza in US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, PCAOB e SOX. Solide capacità analitiche e di pensiero critico, con la capacità di interpretare dati finanziari complessi e sviluppare soluzioni su misura per i clienti. Padronanza dell'inglese; la conoscenza del tedesco, del francese o dell'italiano è un vantaggio. Eccellenti capacità comunicative e interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con team internazionali, coltivare le relazioni con i clienti e gestire le aspettative. Perché unirsi a noi? Sappiamo che la tua carriera è molto più di un semplice lavoro — è un percorso. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a supportarti in ogni passo del cammino: Crescita professionale: accesso a opportunità di apprendimento personalizzate, mentoring e supporto finanziario per ulteriori certificazioni. Flessibilità: modalità di lavoro che ti aiutano a bilanciare vita professionale e personale. Cultura inclusiva: un ambiente diversificato e collaborativo dove la tua prospettiva unica è valorizzata. Strumenti innovativi: sfrutta la tecnologia avanzata e approcci creativi per ridefinire il futuro dell'audit. Lavoro orientato allo scopo: contribuisci a progetti significativi che fanno la differenza per i nostri clienti, la società e il pianeta. Pronto/a a fare la differenza? Unisciti alla nostra community of solvers e aiutaci a plasmare il futuro dell'audit - digitale, sostenibile e globale. Candidati ora!

descriptionByLocale.de: In unserer Audit - Trade, Industries & Services (TIS) Praxis analysieren wir nicht nur Zahlen; wir gewinnen Erkenntnisse, die Unternehmen helfen, in einer sich schnell verändernden Welt zu wachsen, sich anzupassen und erfolgreich zu sein. Wir arbeiten mit einem breiten Spektrum an Kunden zusammen, von globalen Konzernen bis hin zu dynamischen lokalen Unternehmen, und helfen ihnen, Herausforderungen zu meistern, Chancen zu nutzen und eine nachhaltige Zukunft aufzubauen. Durch die Verbindung unserer einzigartigen Perspektiven und den Einsatz modernster Technologie gestalten wir die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung und der Branchen, denen wir dienen. Jedes Projekt ist eine Gelegenheit zu wachsen, Wirkung zu erzielen und zum Aufbau von Vertrauen in der Gesellschaft beizutragen. Übernimm die Verantwortung für die Planung, Durchführung und den Abschluss von Konzern- und Einzelabschlussprüfungen in verschiedenen Nicht-Finanzdienstleistungsbranchen, mit Fokus auf US GAAP und SOX-Tests. Führe SOX-Tests interner Kontrollen in Übereinstimmung mit den neuesten PCAOB-Richtlinien durch und demonstriere deine Expertise in internen Kontrollen für in den USA börsennotierte Konzerne sowie deren wesentliche Tochtergesellschaften in der Schweiz. Arbeite mit internationalen Teams und Kunden zusammen, fördere starke Beziehungen und stelle eine reibungslose Kommunikation über Grenzen hinweg sicher. Fördere die Integration unserer Remote-Teammitglieder und stelle sicher, dass sie Teil unseres lokalen Engagement-Teams sind. Nutze digitale Tools, Datenanalysesoftware und Automatisierungslösungen, um handlungsrelevante Erkenntnisse zu strukturieren, zu visualisieren und zu präsentieren, die für Kunden einen Mehrwert schaffen. Nimm neue Herausforderungen und Wachstumschancen an, entwickle deine Führungsqualitäten und trage zum Erfolg deines Teams und deiner Kunden bei. Ein Hochschulabschluss in Buchhaltung oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet, mit einem abgeschlossenen oder in Bearbeitung befindlichen US CPA (oder einer vergleichbaren Zertifizierung). 3–5 Jahre aktuelle Erfahrung in einer Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, mit fundierten Kenntnissen in US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, PCAOB und SOX. Starke analytische und kritische Denkfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Finanzdaten zu interpretieren und massgeschneiderte Lösungen für Kunden zu entwickeln. Fliessende Englischkenntnisse; Kenntnisse in Deutsch, Französisch oder Italienisch sind ein Vorteil. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, effektiv mit internationalen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, Kundenbeziehungen zu pflegen und Erwartungen zu managen. Warum uns beitreten? Wir verstehen, dass deine Karriere mehr als nur ein Job ist – es ist eine Reise. Deshalb sind wir darauf ausgerichtet, dich auf jedem Schritt des Weges zu unterstützen: Berufliches Wachstum: Zugang zu massgeschneiderten Lernmöglichkeiten, Mentoring und finanzieller Unterstützung für weitere Zertifizierungen. Flexibilität: Arbeitsvereinbarungen, die dir helfen, dein Berufs- und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen. Inklusive Kultur: Eine vielfältige und kollaborative Umgebung, in der deine einzigartige Perspektive geschätzt wird. Innovative Tools: Nutzung modernster Technologie und kreativer Ansätze zur Neugestaltung der Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung. Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Beitrag zu bedeutungsvollen Projekten, die für unsere Kunden, die Gesellschaft und den Planeten einen Unterschied machen. Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Werde Teil unserer Community of Solvers und hilf uns, die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung zu gestalten – digital, nachhaltig und global. Jetzt bewerben!
descriptionByLocale.fr: Au sein de notre pratique Audit - Trade, Industries & Services (TIS), nous ne nous contentons pas d'analyser des chiffres ; nous mettons en lumière des insights qui aident les entreprises à croître, à s'adapter et à réussir dans un monde en rapide évolution. Nous travaillons avec un large éventail de clients, des grandes multinationales aux entreprises locales dynamiques, en les aidant à naviguer dans les défis, à saisir les opportunités et à bâtir un avenir durable. En combinant nos perspectives uniques et en tirant parti des technologies avancées, nous façonnons l'avenir de l'audit et des secteurs que nous servons. Chaque projet est une occasion de grandir, d'avoir un impact et de contribuer à instaurer la confiance dans la société. Prenez en charge la planification, l'exécution et la finalisation des audits de groupe et locaux dans divers secteurs hors services financiers, en mettant l'accent sur les tests US GAAP et SOX. Effectuez des tests de contrôles internes SOX conformément aux dernières directives du PCAOB, en démontrant votre expertise en matière de contrôles internes pour les groupes cotés aux États-Unis ainsi que leurs filiales importantes basées en Suisse. Collaborez avec des équipes et des clients internationaux, en favorisant des relations solides et en assurant une communication fluide par-delà les frontières. Favorisez l'intégration de nos membres d'équipe à distance, en veillant à ce qu'ils fassent partie de notre équipe d'engagement locale. Tirez parti des outils numériques, des logiciels d'analyse de données et des solutions d'automatisation pour structurer, visualiser et présenter des insights exploitables qui apportent de la valeur aux clients. Relevez de nouveaux défis et saisissez les opportunités de croissance, en développant vos compétences en leadership et en contribuant au succès de votre équipe et de vos clients. Diplôme universitaire en comptabilité ou dans un domaine connexe, avec un CPA américain (ou une certification comparable) obtenu ou en cours d'obtention. 3 à 5 ans d'expérience récente dans un cabinet d'expertise comptable, avec une solide maîtrise de l'US GAAP, de l'US GAAS, des IFRS, du PCAOB et du SOX. Solides compétences analytiques et esprit critique, avec la capacité d'interpréter des données financières complexes et de développer des solutions sur mesure pour les clients. Maîtrise de l'anglais ; la connaissance de l'allemand, du français ou de l'italien est un atout. Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et aux relations interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec des équipes internationales, d'entretenir des relations clients et de gérer les attentes. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Nous comprenons que votre carrière est bien plus qu'un emploi – c'est un parcours. C'est pourquoi nous nous engageons à vous soutenir à chaque étape : Développement professionnel : Accès à des opportunités d'apprentissage sur mesure, du mentorat et un soutien financier pour l'obtention de certifications supplémentaires. Flexibilité : Des modalités de travail qui vous aident à concilier vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Culture inclusive : Un environnement diversifié et collaboratif où votre perspective unique est valorisée. Outils innovants : Tirez parti des technologies avancées et des approches créatives pour redéfinir l'avenir de l'audit. Travail porteur de sens : Contribuez à des projets significatifs qui font une différence pour nos clients, la société et la planète. Prêt(e) à avoir un impact ? Rejoignez notre communauté de problem-solvers et aidez-nous à façonner l'avenir de l'audit – numérique, durable et mondial. Postulez dès maintenant !

jobs.title: Associate - Payroll Consulting 80-100%
jobs.description:
• Führe die monatliche Gehaltsabrechnung auf Mandatsbasis aus und berücksichtige dabei alle geltenden Vorschriften und Gesetze.

• Erstelle die Quellensteuer- und Sozialversicherungs-Deklarationen sowie die Lohnausweise.

• Sei die erste Ansprechperson für Kund:innen unterschiedlicher Grössen und Branchen - von kleineren KMU's bis hin zu grösseren Niederlassungen von international tätigen Unternehmen.

• Unterstütze Kund:innen bei ihrer Personaladministration und informiere sie proaktiv über fachliche Neuerungen.

• Pflege den Kontakt zu Kund:innen, Sozialversicherungsbehörden und Quellensteuer-Ämtern.

• Unterstütze bei der Abrechnung von Expatriates und erstelle die Shadow-Payroll.

• Abstimmungen zwischen PK-Rechnungen, Finanzbuchhaltung und Lohnbuchhaltung.

• Verfüge über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich Treuhand.

• Bringe mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in der Lohnbuchhaltung mit und kenne dich mit personaladministrativen Aufgaben aus.

• Vertiefe dein Know-how im Bereich Lohn/Sozialversicherungen und verfolge eine Weiterbildung zur Payroll Spezialist;in, eidg. Fachausweis als HR- oder Sozialversicherungs-Fachmann/-frau als dein langfristiges Ziel.

• Stilsicher in Deutsch und verfüge über sehr gute Englisch-Kenntnisse.

• Verfüge über gute Kenntnisse in SAP oder im Abacus-Lohnmodul und habe gute Excel-Kenntnisse.

• Arbeite genau und effizient und habe Interesse daran, dein Wissen ständig auszubauen.

• Sei motiviert in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten und setze dein Wissen im Lohnbereich gerne als Berater:in für unsere Kund:innen und deren interessanten Anfragen ein.
