jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager Transaction Services
jobs.description:
In Transaction Services you will be at the forefront of our client's M&A activity and lead projects and multidisciplinary, first in class teams.
We are looking for a motivated team player who can help us deliver outstanding client projects and advance our team. A career within the Deals Transaction Services team will provide you with the opportunity to help clients achieve maximum value with their M&A activities. We focus on evaluating M&A projects in due diligence, pre and post completion. We conduct pre deal and confirmatory due diligence, execute large-scale enterprise wide integrations, and support complex divestitures and separations on a wide range of areas.

• Help our clients with dedicated support for transactions in a wide variety of industries and circumstances (acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures & structured investments).

• Work across the areas of buy-side due diligence, sell-side assistance and vendor due diligence, deal and negotiation support for both corporate and private equity clients.

• Collaborate with other experts to develop a rapid understanding of the client's business and issues, and articulate your findings appropriately in order to deliver high quality reports.

• Work in a diversified, international environment covering multiple areas and industries.

• Team up with a network of highly talented and knowledgeable experts.

• Bachelor's or master's degree and have a background in finance (CPA or CFA).

• Thorough understanding of financial accounting and reporting requirements in accordance with internationally recognized reporting standards (e.g. IFRS, US GAAP).

• At least 5 years of experience in providing financial due diligence and other transaction-related services to large companies and private equity fund clients.

• Fluent in English, any other language is a plus.

• You are energetic, proactive, able to empathise with clients and staff, and are enthusiastic about delivering value to clients.

• Flexible and demonstrate willingness to conduct business travel for client assignments or business-related matters.

• Excellent analytical skills and are experienced in using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and additional analytical software tools (e.g. PowerBI, Alteryx) to analyse and present data in a meaningful and efficient way.

jobs.title: Senior Associate / Manager Financial Services Consulting - Liquidity & Funding
jobs.description:
• Join PwC Advisory to become part of our Strategy & Transformation Banking Team in Zurich.

• Be part of our L&F Team and help our banking clients to transform their liquidity and funding practices to improve their opportunity cost efficiency and to fulfil internal and external requirements, while closely collaborating with Finance, Banking Restructuring and Risk Teams.

• BE responsible to further develop the go-to-market strategy for liquidity and funding and manage projects with our key banking clients.

• Developi solutions that will help our clients to efficiently measure, manage and use their liquid assets on a short-term operational and mid-term structural basis and integrate that view into their risk understanding in a rising interest rate environment.

• Continuously further develop the service offering for the liquidity and funding practice and provide thought leadership to the banking sector.

• Be part of a team that operates strongly in an interdisciplinary environment within PwC. You will be using and building bridges to our fellow teams that work at the technological edge in big data analysis and artificial intelligence.

• Work in a global environment with the largest banks, you will be embedded in a network of our company that gathers and shares industry insights in Liquidity & Funding worldwide.

• An excellent University / ETH Master's degree in Banking, Finance, Economics, Business Administration or an adjacent field that enables you to work with banks and other financial service companies.

• A strong affinity for numbers and logical processes, are excellent with Excel and other quantitative programs and feel highly comfortable showing your ideas in Power Point.

• Take responsibility for constantly increasing your knowledge in Banking on a personal, intrinsic basis throughout your career.

• More than 3 years (SA) / 5 years (M) of hands-on experience in the Banking Sector or Consulting and have gathered extensive experience working on liquidity and funding topics incl. Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) and working with Trading, Treasury Departments, Financial Risk or Finance and Accounting Departments.

• Extensive experience with complex banking products.

• Fluent in English. German is a highly significant plus and other languages (e.g. French) are welcome.

• Willing to travel to our client's international locations if required but are not disappointed if you are not needed to leave Zurich at all for a given time.

• Programming skills are highly recommended and beneficial (e.g. python).

• CFA, FRM certificates are a significant plus.

jobs.title: Senior Manager / Director Asset Management – Strategy & Transformation

• Support the Asset Management clients to successfully manage their transformations including but not limited to investment management system selection and implementation, definition of target operating models, definition of data models, etc.

• Be part of a team that operates strongly in an interdisciplinary environment within PwC. You will be using and building bridges to our fellow teams that work at the technological edge in big data analysis, artificial intelligence and robotic process automation.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Cybersecurity & Privacy
jobs.description:
This is an exciting opportunity to join our Cybersecurity & Privacy team, a multidisciplinary group of consultants, engineers, and risk specialists who help clients build digital trust, manage cyber risk, and comply with evolving regulations.

You will benefit from PwC's global network, proven methodologies, and a culture that values inclusion, continuous learning, and practical innovation.

Expect a collaborative environment where you can take ownership of workstreams, coach junior team members, and contribute to thought leadership while developing your expertise through engagements, training, and certifications.

• Deliver client engagements focused on cyber risk and privacy, including assessments, gap analyses, roadmaps, and implementation projects.

• Translate technical and regulatory requirements into pragmatic policies, standards, architectures, and operating procedures tailored to the client's risk appetite.

• Design and implement security controls aligned to frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, and industry regulations (e.g., FINMA circulars, DORA, NIS2).

• Support clients in maturing capabilities across cloud security, identity and access management, data security (encryption, DLP), vulnerability and threat management, security monitoring, and incident response.

• Assess third-party and supply chain cyber risk, define remediation plans, and help establish continuous assurance and vendor oversight processes.

• Advise on privacy compliance and operations (e.g., GDPR, Swiss nFADP), including data protection impact assessments, records of processing activities, data subject rights, cross border transfers, and privacy-by-design.

• Lead workstreams, manage stakeholders, and ensure high-quality deliverables: reports, playbooks, risk registers, control matrices, and board-ready presentations.

• Contribute to business development: shape proposals, respond to RFPs, build repeatable assets, and develop points of view on emerging topics.

• Coach and mentor junior colleagues, foster a culture of teaming and excellence, and stay current with threat trends and regulatory developments.

• 2–5 years of experience in cybersecurity and/or privacy consulting or a similar role (internal or external), with proven delivery of client-facing projects.- Strong knowledge of key frameworks and regulations: ISO/IEC 27001/2, NIST CSF, CIS Controls; awareness of NIS2, CRA, DORA, GDPR, Swiss nFADP and sector-specific guidance (e.g., FINMA) is a plus.

• Practical experience in several of the following: security governance and risk; privacy operations; identity and access management; data security; compliance with cybersecurity and resilience regulations; threat and vulnerability management; security operations and incident response; cloud security.

• Consulting core skills: structured problem-solving, clear writing, confident presentation, stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex topics into actionable recommendations.

• Education in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Law, Business) or equivalent practical experience.

• Professional certifications are advantageous (e.g., SSCP, Security+).

• Language skills: fluent in English; French is a strong asset.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Questa è un'opportunità emozionante per unire il nostro team Cybersecurity & Privacy, un gruppo multidisciplinare di consulenti, ingegneri e specialisti del rischio che aiutano i clienti a costruire la fiducia digitale, gestire il rischio informatico e rispettare le normative in evoluzione. Potrai beneficiare della rete globale di PwC, metodologie collaudate e una cultura che valorizza l'inclusione, l'apprendimento continuo e l'innovazione pratica. Aspettatevi un ambiente collaborativo in cui è possibile prendere la proprietà dei flussi di lavoro, dei membri del team di coach junior e contribuire alla leadership di pensiero, sviluppando le vostre competenze attraverso impegni, formazione e certificazioni. ## Mansioni - Fornire gli impegni dei clienti focalizzati sul rischio informatico e sulla privacy, tra cui valutazioni, analisi del gap, roadmap e progetti di implementazione. - Tradurre requisiti tecnici e normativi in politiche pragmatiche, standard, architetture e procedure operative su misura per l'appetito di rischio del cliente. - Progettare e implementare i controlli di sicurezza allineati a strutture come ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e normative del settore (ad esempio, FINMA circolari, DORA, NIS2). - Sostenere i client nella maturazione delle capacità attraverso la sicurezza cloud, l'identità e la gestione degli accessi, la sicurezza dei dati (crittografia, DLP), la vulnerabilità e la gestione delle minacce, il monitoraggio della sicurezza e la risposta agli incidenti. - Valutare il rischio informatico di terze parti e supply chain, definire piani di bonifica, e contribuire a stabilire processi di supervisione continua di garanzia e fornitore. - Consulenza sulla conformità e sulle operazioni della privacy (ad esempio, GDPR, Swiss nFADP), comprese le valutazioni d'impatto sulla protezione dei dati, i record delle attività di trattamento, i diritti dell'interessato, i trasferimenti transfrontalieri e la privacy-by-design. - Lead workstreams, gestire le parti interessate e garantire consegne di alta qualità: report, playbook, registri di rischio, matrici di controllo e presentazioni di bordo. - Contribuire allo sviluppo aziendale: formulare proposte, rispondere a RFP, costruire attività ripetibili e sviluppare punti di vista su argomenti emergenti. - Coach e mentore colleghi junior, promuovere una cultura del teaming e dell'eccellenza, e rimanere attuali con le tendenze delle minacce e gli sviluppi normativi. ##
• Requisiti - 2–5 anni di esperienza nella consulenza sulla sicurezza informatica e/o sulla privacy o un ruolo simile (internal o esterno), con comprovata consegna di progetti di customer-facing. - Una solida conoscenza dei quadri e dei regolamenti chiave: ISO/IEC 27001/2, NIST CSF, CIS Controls; la consapevolezza di NIS2, CRA, DORA, GDPR, Swiss nFADP e di orientamento settoriale (ad esempio, FINMA) è un vantaggio. - Esperienza pratica in diversi dei seguenti punti: governance della sicurezza e rischio; operazioni sulla privacy; gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso; sicurezza dei dati; conformità alle normative sulla sicurezza informatica e resilienza; gestione delle minacce e delle vulnerabilità; operazioni di sicurezza e risposta agli incidenti; sicurezza del cloud. - Consulenza competenze di base: strutturato problem-solving, scrittura chiara, presentazione sicura, gestione degli stakeholder, e la capacità di tradurre argomenti complessi in raccomandazioni attuabili. - Istruzione in un campo rilevante (ad esempio, Informatica, sicurezza dell'informazione, ingegneria, diritto, affari) o esperienza pratica equivalente. - Le certificazioni professionali sono vantaggiose (ad esempio, SSCP, Security+). - Capacità linguistiche: fluente in inglese; il francese è un bene forte. # Cosa # Nessun beneficio specifico elencato. ## Contatto Nessun dato di contatto specifico fornito.

Conseils sur le respect de la vie privée et les opérations (par exemple, RGPD, nFADP suisse), y compris les évaluations d'impact sur la protection des données, les dossiers des activités de traitement, les droits des personnes concernées, les transferts transfrontaliers et la protection de la vie privée par conception. - Diriger les flux de travail, gérer les intervenants et assurer la qualité des produits livrables : rapports, livres de lecture, registres des risques, matrices de contrôle et présentations prêtes au conseil. - Contribuer au développement des entreprises : façonner les propositions, répondre aux demandes de propositions, construire des biens reproductibles et élaborer des points de vue sur des sujets émergents. - Entraîner et mentorer les jeunes collègues, favoriser une culture d'équipe et d'excellence, et rester au courant des tendances des menaces et des développements réglementaires. ##
• Requisiti - 2–5 ans d'expérience en cybersécurité et/ou en consultation sur la protection de la vie privée ou un rôle semblable (interne ou externe), avec la réalisation éprouvée de projets orientés vers le client. - Forte connaissance des principaux cadres et règlements : ISO/IEC 27001/2, CCA NIST, CIS Controls; sensibilisation aux NIS2, CRA, DORA, RGPD, NFADP suisse et orientations sectorielles (par exemple, FINMA) est un atout. - Expérience pratique dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : gouvernance et risques en matière de sécurité; opérations relatives à la protection de la vie privée; gestion de l'identité et de l'accès; sécurité des données; respect des règlements en matière de cybersécurité et de résilience; gestion des menaces et de la vulnérabilité; opérations de sécurité et interventions en cas d'incident; sécurité du cloud. - Consultation des compétences de base : résolution structurée de problèmes, rédaction claire, présentation confiante, gestion des intervenants et capacité de traduire des sujets complexes en recommandations réalisables. - Éducation dans un domaine pertinent (p. ex. informatique, sécurité de l'information, génie, droit, affaires) ou expérience pratique équivalente. - Les certifications professionnelles sont avantageuses (par exemple, SSCP, Security+). - Compétences linguistiques : maîtrise de l'anglais; le français est un atout important.

jobs.title: Manager - Digital Audit (Financial Services)
jobs.description:
Stell dir vor, du bist Teil eines Teams, das Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, ihre IT- und Geschäftsprozesse zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Bei PwC im Bereich Digital Audit-Financial Services arbeitest du mit Expert:innen zusammen, die mit Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist die digitale Transformation der Finanzwelt vorantreiben.

Ob Banken, Versicherungen oder Asset Manager-wir analysieren IT-gestützte Prozesse, identifizieren Risiken und entwickeln innovative Lösungen, die Vertrauen schaffen. Dabei setzen wir auf modernste Technologien, datenbasierte Ansätze und ein starkes Team, das Vielfalt lebt und voneinander lernt.

• Führe anspruchsvolle Digital-Audit-Projekte durch, insbesondere im Bereich IT General Controls (ITGCs), und unterstütze bei der Prüfung von ERP-Systemen und Geschäftsprozessen.

• Identifiziere Schwachstellen in IT-Kontrollsystemen, analysiere Risiken und entwickle massgeschneiderte Empfehlungen zur Optimierung.

• Entwickle innovative Lösungen, die auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse und Herausforderungen unserer Kunden eingehen.

• Baue starke Kundenbeziehungen auf, präsentiere überzeugend und gewinne neue Projekte, um unsere Marktposition weiter zu stärken.

• Nutze modernste Technologien wie Datenanalysen, Automatisierung und KI, um unsere Prüfungsprozesse effizienter und zukunftsorientierter zu gestalten.

• Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Information System Management, Management oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

• CISA- oder CISM-Zertifizierung.

• 5-6 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen IT-Audit, IT-Consulting oder der Prüfung von IT-gestützten Geschäftsprozessen bei einer Big4 Firma.

• Nachweisbare Erfolge im Business Development sowie in der Leitung von Angeboten und Pitches.

• Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Projektmanagement und in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams.

• Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung im Verfassen präziser Berichte auf Deutsch und Englisch - Französisch von Vorteil.

• Prüfung von KI-/ML-Modellen oder AI Governance-oder die Bereitschaft, sich in diese zukunftsweisenden Themen einzuarbeiten

• Cloud-Technologien und Cloud Security (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

• Cybersecurity und IT-Risikomanagement

• Finance transformation

• Data Analytics und Data Governance

• Robotic Process Automation (RPA) und intelligente Automatisierung

• Blockchain-Technologien und Digital Assets

jobs.title: Manager – U.S. Tax (Private Clients)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled U.S. Tax Manager to lead and manage complex tax engagements for our private clients. In this role, you will leverage your comprehensive understanding of U.S. tax regulations and financial planning to provide strategic tax planning and compliance services tailored to high-net-worth individuals. Your ability to interpret complex tax data will be essential in navigating the ever-evolving tax landscape for our clients.

In this role, you will:

• Build and maintain strong relationships with private clients, understanding their unique financial needs and delivering tailored tax solutions.

• Develop and implement tax planning strategies that align with client objectives and industry standards, maximizing tax efficiencies for high-net-worth individuals.

• Oversee the preparation and review of complex tax returns, ensuring compliance with U.S. tax regulations and internal standards.

• Provide expert guidance on complex tax issues, leveraging your in-depth knowledge of U.S. tax regulations and their application to private client scenarios.

• Interpret and analyze tax data to generate insightful reports and recommendations, assisting clients in making informed financial decisions.

• A minimum of 5 years of U.S. taxation experience with an international accounting firm or similar, specializing in U.S. compliance and consulting tax issues for high-net-worth individuals.

• A bachelor's degree with a specialization in accounting/taxation or a law degree from an accredited university.

• CPA or IRS Enrolled Agent qualification.

• Extensive technical skills relevant to private clients, coupled with a successful track record in identifying client needs and pursuing new service opportunities.

• Proven leadership experience, including establishing direction, motivating team members, and fostering innovation.

• Demonstrated success in generating new business, writing proposals, and collaborating across engagements and business units.

• Advanced knowledge of tax compliance software and proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

jobs.description:
Du bist Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur Zahlen prüft, sondern Zusammenhänge erkennt. Bei PwC im Bereich Audit - Financial Services (Versicherungen) analysierst du Unternehmen: Wie erfolgreich sind sie? Wo liegen Chancen und Risiken? Wie können sie nachhaltiger werden?

Hier arbeitest du mit neugierigen und ambitionierten Menschen, um die Wirtschaft von morgen zu gestalten – digital, nachhaltig und global. Jedes Projekt ist einzigartig und bietet dir die Chance, zu wachsen und einen Unterschied zu machen.

Vielfalt ist unsere Stärke. Deine Perspektive zählt, und wir unterstützen dich, deine Ziele zu erreichen.

Du willst nicht einfach nur einen Job, sondern etwas bewirken? Willkommen bei PwC! Hier kannst du:
• Unternehmen verstehen und transformieren: Prüfe Konzern- und Jahresabschlüsse und stelle sicher, dass diese den regulatorischen Anforderungen entsprechen - vor Ort, im Office oder flexibel aus dem Homeoffice.

• Digital die Zukunft gestalten: Nutze modernste Tools, KI und Datenanalyse, um die Wirtschaftsprüfung auf ein neues Level zu heben. Deine Ideen zählen!

• Nachhaltigkeit vorantreiben: Unterstütze bei der Prüfung von ESG-Berichten und begleite Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Umweltbewusstsein und sozialer Verantwortung.

• Netzwerke aufbauen: Arbeite mit Führungsteams und CFOs zusammen und knüpfe Kontakte, die deine Karriere prägen werden.

• Verantwortung übernehmen: Entwickle deine Leadership-Skills in einem internationalen Team, das dich fördert und inspiriert. Besonders in der intensiven Busy Season von Januar bis Ostern leistest du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden.

Solltest du dir noch unsicher sein, wie der Alltag in der Wirtschaftsprüfung aussieht, dann probiere unsere Virtual Case Experience aus. In 3-4 Stunden kannst du reale betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen lösen und einen Einblick in die Praxis gewinnen.

Bei uns zählen deine Persönlichkeit, deine Skills und dein Wille, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen. Was du ausserdem mitbringen solltest:

• Einen bevorstehenden oder abgeschlossenen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, STEM oder einer anderen Studienrichtung.

• Begeisterung für Zahlen, digitale Trends und Nachhaltigkeit.

• Den Wunsch, in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mit Menschen aus verschiedenen Kulturen zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen mit frischen Ideen zu lösen.

Deine Perspektive - Mehr als nur ein Job
Wir wissen, dass der Start ins Berufsleben aufregend, aber auch herausfordernd sein kann. Deshalb begleiten wir dich auf deinem Weg - mit einem klaren Plan und starker Unterstützung:
• Zeitliche und finanzielle Förderung: Wir unterstützen dich umfassend bei deiner Weiterbildung zur/zum dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in. Du erhältst nicht nur finanzielle Unterstützung, sondern auch die Flexibilität, deine Lernzeit optimal zu gestalten.

• Flexibilität, die zu dir passt: Unsere Arbeitszeitmodelle geben dir die Freiheit, Beruf, Lernen und Freizeit in Einklang zu bringen.

• Mentoring und Entwicklung: Du wirst von erfahrenen Kolleg:innen begleitet, die dich fördern und inspirieren.

• Ein Team, das dich stärkt: Bei uns findest du eine Gemeinschaft, die Vielfalt schätzt, Ideen feiert und dich ermutigt, über dich hinauszuwachsen.

Warum PwC? Weil wir wissen, was dir wichtig ist. Sinnvolle Arbeit, die einen Unterschied macht. Ein Team, das dich inspiriert. Und die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Community of Solvers. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung - digital, nachhaltig und global.

Le tue idee contano! - Promuovere la sostenibilità: supporta nella verifica dei rapporti ESG e accompagna le aziende nel loro percorso verso una maggiore consapevolezza ambientale e responsabilità sociale. - Costruire reti: lavora con team di leadership e CFO e stabilisci contatti che daranno forma alla tua carriera. - Assumersi responsabilità: sviluppa le tue abilità di leadership in un team internazionale che ti promuove e ti ispira. Soprattutto nella intensa stagione di lavoro da gennaio a Pasqua, dai un contributo decisivo al successo dei nostri clienti. ##

Per noi contano la tua personalità, le tue abilità e la tua volontà di rendere il mondo un po' migliore. • Cosa offriamo La tua prospettiva - più di un lavoro Sappiamo che l'inizio della vita lavorativa può essere emozionante, ma anche impegnativo. Ecco perché ti accompagniamo nel tuo percorso - con un piano chiaro e un forte supporto: - Promozione temporale e finanziaria: ti supportiamo completamente nella tua formazione come revisore contabile diplomato. Non solo ricevi un sostegno finanziario, ma anche la flessibilità per organizzare al meglio il tuo tempo di apprendimento. - Flessibilità che si adatta a te: i nostri modelli di orario di lavoro ti danno la libertà di conciliare lavoro, apprendimento e tempo libero. - Mentorship e sviluppo: sarai accompagnato da colleghi esperti che ti promuovono e ti ispirano. - Un team che ti sostiene: da noi trovi una comunità che apprezza la diversità, celebra le idee e ti incoraggia a superare te stesso. ## Contatto

Description You are part of a team that not only checks numbers but recognizes connections. At PwC in the Audit - Financial Services (Insurance) department, you analyze companies: How successful are they? Where are the opportunities and risks? How can they become more sustainable? Here, you work with curious and ambitious people to shape the economy of tomorrow - digital, sustainable, and global. Every project is unique and offers you the chance to grow and make a difference. Diversity is our strength. Your perspective counts, and we support you in achieving your goals. Do you want more than just a job, but something to achieve? Welcome to PwC! Here you can: - Understand and transform companies: Audit consolidated and annual financial statements and ensure they meet regulatory requirements - on site, in the office, or flexibly from home. - Digitally shape the future: Use state-of-the-art tools, AI, and data analysis to take auditing to a new level. Your ideas count! - Drive sustainability: Support the verification of ESG reports and accompany companies on their path to greater environmental awareness and social responsibility. - Build networks: Work with leadership teams and CFOs and make contacts that will shape your career. - Take responsibility: Develop your leadership skills in an international team that promotes and inspires you. Especially during the intense busy season from January to Easter, you make a decisive contribution to the success of our customers. ##
• Requirements If you're still unsure what everyday life in auditing looks like, try our Virtual Case Experience. In 3-4 hours, you can solve real business-related questions and get an insight into practice. For us, your personality, skills, and willingness to make the world a little better count. In addition to this, you should: - Have an upcoming or completed Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, (Business) Informatics, STEM, or another field of study. - Be enthusiastic about numbers, digital trends, and sustainability. - Desire to work in an international environment and collaborate with people from different cultures. - Strong communication in German and English. - Team spirit and the ability to solve challenges with fresh ideas. ##
• What we offer Your perspective - more than just a job We know that starting your working life can be exciting but also challenging. That's why we accompany you on your journey - with a clear plan and strong support: - Time and financial support: We comprehensively support you in your training as a certified auditor. You not only receive financial support but also the flexibility to optimally design your learning time. - Flexibility that suits you: Our working time models give you the freedom to balance work, learning, and leisure. - Mentoring and development: You will be accompanied by experienced colleagues who promote and inspire you. - A team that strengthens you: Here, you find a community that appreciates diversity, celebrates ideas, and encourages you to grow beyond yourself. ## Contact Apply now and become part of our Community of Solvers. Together, we design the future of auditing - digital, sustainable, and global.

jobs.title: Director - Cloud, Data & AI (CD&AI) - Generative AI
jobs.description:
• You manage engagements with clients and PwC teams, serving as a key leader within our organization.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them navigate the complexities of AI adoption

• Lead workshops and discussions with clients or internal stakeholders to identify AI use cases, understand business challenges, and align AI tailored solutions.

• Facilitate your clients' advancement in digitization by gathering their requirements and proposing state-of-the-art solutions.

• Anticipate and address potential risks associated with AI implementation, such as data privacy, security, and model performance.

• Implement and continuously expand your knowledge of best practices in technology, data engineering, analytics, and consulting approach.

• A university master's degree or PhD in fields such as artificial intelligence, computer science, physics, mathematics, or any natural sciences or engineering discipline is preferred.

• Over 10 years of work experience evidencing experience with artificial intelligence technologies (such as machine learning, deep learning, advanced statistics and modelling) and more recently in Generative AI (including Agentic AI, GenAI-related cloud technologies, ML engineering).

• As experienced hire, you have a solid track record in delivering and overachieving on your projects and you can rely on your network within AI space.

• Proven experience in AI leadership roles, with a track record of delivering impactful AI solutions. Consulting experienced is considered a plus.

• Proven go-to-market experience within the Swiss market is mandatory, with a strong understanding of local business dynamics and needs.

• Fluency in English with a willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally internationally; German or French language skills are considered a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Supply Chain Cyber Security Specialist (Cyber Risk Advisory)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Associate in our Cybersecurity and Privacy team, you will play a key role in delivering and growing our supply chain cyber risk capability across all sectors of clients. You will help our clients strengthen their third-party cyber risk management programs, comply with evolving regulatory expectations such as DORA, NIS2, and respond to emerging threats across complex, global supply chains.

This is a growth-focused role, supporting engagements across multiple financial services and non-financial services clients, many of which are part of multi-year transformation programs.

As part of the Cybersecurity and Privacy team of PwC Switzerland, you will work on:
• delivering client engagements focused on supply chain cyber security, third party risk, and compliance with DORA, NIS2, and related regulations across industries;

• designing and implementing supplier segmentation, cyber risk assessments, control testing, continuous monitoring, and incident response processes as part of broader Supplier Risk and IT GRC transformations;

• collaborating with clients to define and operationalize future state Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) operating models, including roles and responsibilities, escalation paths, and response plans;

• building AI augmented TPRM capabilities and workflows leveraging platforms such as ServiceNow, ProcessUnity, BitSight, RiskRecon, and SecurityScorecard, including tooling configuration and integrations;

• developing pragmatic recommendations and roadmaps to improve cyber risk governance, continuous monitoring, and incident/issue management across the third party lifecycle;

• leading and contributing to workshops, reporting, and executive ready presentations for CISO, CIO, Risk, Compliance, and Procurement stakeholders;

• supporting internal capability building, contributing to thought leadership, market propositions, proposal responses, and account expansion initiatives; and

• coaching and mentoring junior team members while fostering a high performance, inclusive team culture.

We are looking for a Senior Associate who embodies our core values and brings a strong background in cyber security:

• You have at minimum 5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, third-party risk, or supply chain risk management.

• You have a master's or bachelor's degree or an equivalent professional qualification in business administration or computer science. Additional certificates such as CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CISSP are a plus.

• Proven experience working with financial services clients, ideally within regulatory-driven engagements (e.g., DORA, NIS2).

• Strong understanding of supply chain cybersecurity frameworks, supplier risk segmentation, control testing, and cyber risk quantification.

• Familiarity with supply chain risk platforms such as ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, BitSight, RiskRecon, or equivalent.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and client-facing skills.

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with all levels of management and staff.

• You are fluent in English and (ideally) also in German and/or French.

• You have a high degree of initiative, self-organisation and sense of responsibility.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come Senior Associate nel nostro team di Cybersecurity e Privacy, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo e nella crescita delle nostre capacità di gestione del rischio cyber nella supply chain in tutti i settori dei clienti. Aiuterai i nostri clienti a rafforzare i loro programmi di gestione del rischio cyber di terze parti, a conformarsi alle crescenti aspettative normative come DORA, NIS2, e a rispondere alle minacce emergenti nelle supply chain complesse e globali. Questo è un ruolo orientato alla crescita, che supporta engagement su più clienti di servizi finanziari e non finanziari, molti dei quali fanno parte di programmi di trasformazione pluriennali. Come parte del team di Cybersecurity e Privacy di PwC Switzerland, lavorerai su: erogazione di engagement con i clienti focalizzati sulla sicurezza informatica della supply chain, il rischio di terze parti e la conformità a DORA, NIS2 e normative correlate in vari settori; progettazione e implementazione della segmentazione dei fornitori, valutazioni del rischio cyber, test dei controlli, monitoraggio continuo e processi di risposta agli incidenti nell'ambito di trasformazioni più ampie di Supplier Risk e IT GRC; collaborazione con i clienti per definire e operativizzare i modelli operativi futuri di Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), inclusi ruoli e responsabilità, percorsi di escalation e piani di risposta; costruzione di capacità e flussi di lavoro TPRM arricchiti dall'IA sfruttando piattaforme come ServiceNow, ProcessUnity, BitSight, RiskRecon e SecurityScorecard, incluse configurazione e integrazioni degli strumenti; sviluppo di raccomandazioni pragmatiche e roadmap per migliorare la governance del rischio cyber, il monitoraggio continuo e la gestione degli incidenti/problemi lungo il ciclo di vita della terza parte; guida e contributo a workshop, reportistica e presentazioni executive per stakeholder CISO, CIO, Risk, Compliance e Procurement; supporto alla costruzione di capacità interne, contribuendo alla leadership di pensiero, proposizioni di mercato, risposte a proposte e iniziative di espansione degli account; e coaching e mentoring dei membri junior del team, promuovendo una cultura di team inclusiva e ad alte prestazioni.
• Stiamo cercando un Senior Associate che incarni i nostri valori fondamentali e abbia una solida esperienza nella sicurezza informatica: Hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza rilevante in cybersecurity, rischio di terze parti o gestione del rischio nella supply chain. Hai una laurea magistrale o triennale o una qualifica professionale equivalente in amministrazione aziendale o informatica. Certificazioni aggiuntive come CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CISSP sono un plus. Esperienza comprovata nel lavoro con clienti di servizi finanziari, idealmente nell'ambito di engagement guidati da normative (es. DORA, NIS2). Solida comprensione dei framework di cybersecurity della supply chain, segmentazione del rischio dei fornitori, test dei controlli e quantificazione del rischio cyber. Familiarità con piattaforme di rischio della supply chain come ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, BitSight, RiskRecon o equivalenti. Eccellenti capacità comunicative, di coinvolgimento degli stakeholder e orientamento al cliente. Hai forti capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta per interagire efficacemente con tutti i livelli del management e del personale. Sei fluente in inglese e (idealmente) anche in tedesco e/o francese. Hai un alto grado di iniziativa, autoorganizzazione e senso di responsabilità.

Sie helfen unseren Kunden, ihre Third-Party-Cyber-Risikomanagementprogramme zu stärken, sich an die sich entwickelnden regulatorischen
• Anforderungen wie DORA, NIS2 anzupassen und auf neue Bedrohungen in komplexen, globalen Lieferketten zu reagieren. Wir suchen einen Senior Associate, der unsere Kernwerte verkörpert und einen starken Hintergrund in der Cybersicherheit mitbringt: Sie verfügen über mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in Cybersicherheit, Third-Party-Risiko oder Supply-Chain-Risikomanagement. Sie haben einen Master- oder Bachelor-Abschluss oder eine gleichwertige professionelle Qualifikation in Betriebswirtschaft oder Informatik. Zusätzliche Zertifikate wie CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CISSP sind ein Plus. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kunden aus dem Finanzdienstleistungsbereich, idealerweise im Rahmen regulierungsgetriebener Engagements (z. B. DORA, NIS2). Fundiertes Verständnis von Supply-Chain-Cybersicherheits-Frameworks, Lieferantenrisikosegmentierung, Kontrollprüfung und Cyber-Risikoquantifizierung. Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Risikoplattformen wie ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, BitSight, RiskRecon oder Äquivalenten. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations-, Stakeholder-Engagement- und Kundenbetreuungsfähigkeiten. Sie verfügen über starke mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um effektiv mit allen Führungs- und Mitarbeiterstufen zu interagieren. Sie sind fliessend in Englisch und (idealerweise) auch in Deutsch und/oder Französisch. Sie haben ein hohes Mass an Initiative, Selbstorganisation und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.
descriptionByLocale.fr: En tant que Senior Associate au sein de notre équipe Cybersécurité et Confidentialité, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la mise en œuvre et le développement de notre capacité de gestion des risques cyber de la chaîne d'approvisionnement dans tous les secteurs clients. Vous aiderez nos clients à renforcer leurs programmes de gestion des risques cyber tiers, à se conformer aux exigences réglementaires en évolution telles que DORA, NIS2, et à répondre aux menaces émergentes dans des chaînes d'approvisionnement complexes et mondiales. Il s'agit d'un rôle axé sur la croissance, soutenant des missions auprès de plusieurs clients de services financiers et non financiers, dont beaucoup font partie de programmes de transformation pluriannuels. En tant que membre de l'équipe Cybersécurité et Confidentialité de PwC Switzerland, vous travaillerez sur : la réalisation de missions clients axées sur la cybersécurité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, le risque tiers et la conformité à DORA, NIS2 et réglementations connexes dans différents secteurs ; la conception et la mise en œuvre de la segmentation des fournisseurs, des évaluations des risques cyber, des tests de contrôles, de la surveillance continue et des processus de réponse aux incidents dans le cadre de transformations plus larges du Supplier Risk et IT GRC ; la collaboration avec les clients pour définir et opérationnaliser les modèles opérationnels futurs de Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), incluant les rôles et responsabilités, les voies d'escalade et les plans de réponse ; la construction de capacités et workflows TPRM augmentés par l'IA en tirant parti de plateformes telles que ServiceNow, ProcessUnity, BitSight, RiskRecon et SecurityScorecard, incluant la configuration des outils et les intégrations ; le développement de recommandations pragmatiques et de feuilles de route pour améliorer la gouvernance des risques cyber, la surveillance continue et la gestion des incidents/problèmes tout au long du cycle de vie des tiers ; la direction et la contribution à des ateliers, des rapports et des présentations prêtes pour la direction pour les parties prenantes RSSI, DSI, Risque, Conformité et Achats ; le soutien au développement des capacités internes, la contribution au leadership éclairé, aux propositions de marché, aux réponses aux appels d'offres et aux initiatives d'expansion des comptes ; et le coaching et le mentorat des membres juniors de l'équipe tout en favorisant une culture d'équipe inclusive et performante. Nous recherchons un Senior Associate qui incarne nos valeurs fondamentales et apporte une solide expérience en cybersécurité : Vous avez au minimum 5 ans d'expérience pertinente en cybersécurité, en risque tiers ou en gestion des risques de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Vous êtes titulaire d'un master ou d'une licence ou d'une qualification professionnelle équivalente en administration des affaires ou en informatique. Des certifications supplémentaires telles que CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CISSP sont un plus. Expérience avérée dans le travail avec des clients de services financiers, idéalement dans le cadre de missions réglementaires (ex. DORA, NIS2). Solide compréhension des frameworks de cybersécurité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de la segmentation des risques fournisseurs, des tests de contrôles et de la quantification des risques cyber. Familiarité avec les plateformes de risque de la chaîne d'approvisionnement telles que ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, BitSight, RiskRecon ou équivalents. Excellentes compétences en communication, en engagement des parties prenantes et en relation client. Vous avez de solides compétences en communication verbale et écrite pour interagir efficacement avec tous les niveaux de la direction et du personnel. Vous maîtrisez l'anglais et (idéalement) également l'allemand et/ou le français. Vous avez un haut degré d'initiative, d'auto-organisation et de sens des responsabilités.

jobs.title: Senior associate - Data Protection Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to contribute to the successful delivery of Cyber Technology & Transformation engagements?
This is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing Cyber Technology and Transformation team. We support our clients along the whole cyber security journey, ranging from technology assessments, identification and implementation of cyber solutions, defining cyber strategy and many more. You benefit from a great team to work with and from our broad engagements enabling you to growth personally and professionally.

• As a member of our Cybersecurity consulting team, specializing in Data Protection, you will bring deep technical expertise to help clients secure and protect their most valuable data.

• You will lead and deliver hands-on implementation and configuration of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions - from initial setup through optimization - ensuring clients get maximum value from their investments.

• You will work with cutting edge data security projects and assist in defining requirements, use cases, strategy, including areas such as AI, Quantum and architecture for Data Protection solutions.

• Proven experience in end-to-end data protection projects: scoping, setup, policy design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation tuning.

• 3+ years of hands-on technical experience implementing, configuring, and operating DLP solutions (Microsoft Purview DLP, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or equivalent technologies).

• Strong technical understanding of data protection concepts, data classification, sensitive data handling, and endpoint/network/cloud DLP controls.

• Experience in a consulting or client-facing delivery role is considered advantageous.

• Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills. Fluent in English; German and/or French are a plus.

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or another equivalent technical education; professional certifications (CISSP, CISM, CRISC, Microsoft Security certifications) are a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Capability Leader Data Security
jobs.description:
Are you ready to contribute to the successful delivery of Cyber Technology & Transformation engagements?
This is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing Cyber Technology and Transformation team. We support our clients along the whole cyber security journey, ranging from technology assessments, identification and implementation of cyber solutions, defining cyber strategy and many more. You benefit from a great team to work with and from our broad engagements enabling you to growth personally and professionally.

• As a senior member of our Cybersecurity consulting team, specializing in Data Protection you will lead our team of experts on the topic of Data Protection in helping clients secure and protect their most valuable data.

• You will be responsible for driving strategic efforts to expand our client base, fostering partnerships, and contributing to our team's overall growth trajectory.

• You will help our clients to implement end to end data protection solutions, identifying gaps and recommending improvements that secure their data and satisfy Swiss and global regulatory requirements.

• You will join our extended leadership team in Cyber Security, alongside leading experts in Identity and Access Management, Third Party Risk, Cyber Threat intelligence and Cloud Security.

• You will cultivate a collaborative environment within a team of security experts and a global network, focusing on building strong internal and external relationships. Foster a supportive, friendly, and flexible work environment to ensure the success and well-being of our team.

• Oversee Data Protection programs, establishing yourself as a trusted advisor to our clients and being accountable for project delivery. Additionally, you will manage our partnerships with Data Protection vendors.

• Coach and develop team members on their career path, while contributing to our team growth strategy.

• 10+ years of experience in Information Security, GRC or related domains. Having worked in consulting is considered advantageous.

• You have a technical understanding and hands on experience in various Data Protection technologies such as Microsoft, Broadcomm, and familiarity with technologies such as data masking, encryption, cloud based security, and tokenisation

• You have experience with Data Protection feasibility assessments, solution architectures, implementations and operational experience running data protection programs.

jobs.title: Senior Associate / Assistant Manager - Audit Trade, Industries & Services
jobs.description:
In deiner Rolle als erfahrener Profi im Bereich Audit – Trade, Industries & Services bei PwC bist du Teil eines Teams, bei dem deine Erfahrung und Perspektive zählt. Wir legen großen Wert auf Vielfalt und unterstützen dich dabei, deine beruflichen Ziele zu erreichen, deine Kompetenzen weiter auszubauen und neue Herausforderungen zu meistern.

Du gestaltest die Wirtschaft von morgen mit – digital, nachhaltig und global.

• Du prüfst Jahres- und Konzernrechnungen bei nationalen und internationalen Konzernen und Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Industrie, Handel und dem Dienstleistungssektor.

• Geschäftsprozesse werden von dir geprüft und du leistest Hilfestellung bei Fragen zur Rechnungslegung nach verschiedenen Standards (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP FER, US GAAP).

• Mit dem/der Engagement Manager:in arbeitest du an der Planung, Durchführung und Finalisierung verschiedener Prüfaufträge sowie verschiedener Sonderprüfungen und bist dabei im direkten Austausch mit weiteren Fachspezialist:innen.

• Du bist Teil der digitalen Revolution der Wirtschaftsprüfung, indem du unsere digitalen Prüftools und -ansätze einsetzt und mithilfst, sie zu verbessern.

• Der Erwerb von vertieften Kenntnissen eines breiten Kundenspektrums und das Aufbauen sowie Pflegen von Kundenbeziehungen sprechen dich an.

• Du wirst von uns in deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung durch On- und Off-the-Job-Coaching unterstützt, um deine langfristigen Karriereziele zu erreichen.

• Als Teil eines inspirierenden, diversifizierten Team befindest du dich in einem internationalen Netzwerk und erhältst regelmässig Feedback von Kolleg:innen und Vorgesetzten.

• Du absolvierst die Ausbildung zum/zur Dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in oder hast diese soeben abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung mit und hast dabei Einblicke in betriebswirtschaftliche Prüfungen von Unternehmen gewonnen.

• Du hast ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch an dich und das Team und möchtest aktiv die Digitalisierung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung vorantreiben.

• Du bist motiviert und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die Ansprüche unserer Kund:innen zu übertreffen.

• Du bist bereit, von Anfang an Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich in einem Umfeld mit einer aktiven Coachingkultur zu bewegen.

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Attribuiamo grande importanza alla diversità e ti supportiamo nel raggiungimento dei tuoi obiettivi professionali, nello sviluppo ulteriore delle tue capacità e nell'affrontare nuove sfide. Contribuirai a plasmare l'economia di domani: digitale, sostenibile e globale.
• Effettuate la revisione dei bilanci annuali e consolidati di enti e società nazionali e internazionali dei settori industriale, commerciale e dei servizi.
• Verificherete i processi aziendali e fornirete assistenza in caso di domande sulla contabilità secondo diversi standard (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP FER, US GAAP).
• Lavorerai con l'Engagement Manager alla pianificazione, implementazione e finalizzazione di vari ordini di test nonché di vari test speciali e sarai in contatto diretto con altri specialisti.
• Farai parte della rivoluzione digitale nell'auditing utilizzando e contribuendo a migliorare i nostri strumenti e approcci all'auditing digitale.
• Acquisire una conoscenza approfondita di un'ampia gamma di clienti e costruire e mantenere relazioni con i clienti ti attrae.
• Ti supporteremo nel tuo sviluppo professionale e personale attraverso coaching dentro e fuori dal lavoro per raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi di carriera a lungo termine.
• Come parte di un team stimolante e diversificato, farai parte di una rete internazionale e riceverai feedback regolari da colleghi e superiori.
• Stai completando o hai appena completato la formazione per diventare un auditor qualificato.
• Hai almeno due anni di esperienza professionale nella revisione contabile e hai acquisito conoscenze in materia di audit aziendali delle aziende.
• Possiedi forti capacità analitiche, elevati standard di qualità per te stesso e per il team e vorresti promuovere attivamente la digitalizzazione nell'auditing.
• Sei motivato e aiuti a progettare soluzioni per superare le richieste dei nostri clienti.
• Sei pronto ad assumerti responsabilità fin dall'inizio e a lavorare in un ambiente con una cultura del coaching attiva.
• Hai ottime competenze scritte e parlate di tedesco e inglese.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In your role as an experienced professional in the Audit – Trade, Industries & Services department at PwC, you are part of a team where your experience and perspective count. We attach great importance to diversity and support you in achieving your professional goals, further developing your skills and mastering new challenges. You will help shape the economy of tomorrow – digital, sustainable and global.
• You audit annual and consolidated financial statements of national and international corporations and companies from the industrial, commercial and service sectors.
• You will check business processes and provide assistance with questions about accounting according to various standards (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP FER, US GAAP).
• You will work with the Engagement Manager on the planning, implementation and finalization of various test orders as well as various special tests and will be in direct contact with other specialists.
• You will be part of the digital revolution in auditing by using and helping to improve our digital auditing tools and approaches.
• Acquiring in-depth knowledge of a wide range of customers and building and maintaining customer relationships appeals to you.
• We will support you in your professional and personal development through on- and off-the-job coaching to achieve your long-term career goals.
• As part of an inspiring, diversified team, you will be in an international network and receive regular feedback from colleagues and superiors.
• You are completing or have just completed training to become a qualified auditor.
• You have at least two years of professional experience in auditing and have gained insights into business audits of companies.
• You have strong analytical skills, high quality standards for yourself and the team and would like to actively promote digitalization in auditing.
• You are motivated and help design solutions to exceed the demands of our customers.
• You are ready to take on responsibility right from the start and work in an environment with an active coaching culture.
• You have very good written and spoken German and English skills.

jobs.title: Associate / Senior Associate - Cloud, Data & AI (Data Engineering)
jobs.description:
• Collaborate with your team to deliver high-impact projects and engage with senior stakeholders from high-profile clients in industries such as Pharma & Life Sciences, Financial Services, Retail & Consumer, Industrial Manufacturing, and Public Services.

• Empower your clients to innovatively leverage their data by proposing and developing the most suitable data-driven solutions according to the clients' needs and the availability/properties of their data.

• Assist your clients in advancing digitization with data pipelines and analyzes of various data sources. The projects you are working on include the technical and analytical development of end-to-end data engineering, analytics, and automation solutions.

• Challenge the status quo, seek the information you need, understand the challenge at hand, and devise creative and simple solutions.

• Implement and continue learning best practices in technology, data engineering, analytics, and consulting approaches

• A university degree in fields such as business informatics, computer science, physics, mathematics, or any engineering discipline is preferred.

• Initial work experience in data engineering, data science, visualization, or analytics (including thesis work) adds value.

• Proficiency in multiple programming languages like Python, R, SQL, or similar is required.

• Hands-on experience with Azure, GCP, AWS, or DataBricks is essential.

• Excellent interpersonal, listening, and communication skills, coupled with a proactive attitude towards delivering client value, are vital.

• Fluency in English and German and a willingness to travel within Switzerland, and occasionally internationally, are necessary.

jobs.title: Life Transformation Aktuar/-in – Manager/in
jobs.description:
• Du berätst führende Lebens-(Rück-) Versicherungsgesellschaften in der Schweiz im Rahmen strategischer Transformationsprojekte, z. B. Systemmigrationen, Prozessoptimierungen oder Modernisierungen von aktuariellen Funktionen.

• Du bringst aktuarielles Fachwissen in multidisziplinäre Teams ein und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen aktuariellen, IT- und Business-Funktionen.

• Du analysierst und optimierst bestehende aktuariellen Modelle, Tarifierungs- oder Reservierungsprozesse.

• Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einzelne Projektstreams oder leitest kleinere Projektteams.

• Du unterstützt beim Auf- und Ausbau von Kundenbeziehungen und trägst zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsangebots im Bereich Life Insurance bei.

• Du verfügst über einen Universitätsabschluss in Mathematik, Statistik, Actuarial Science oder Naturwissenschaften.

• Du hast 5–8 Jahre relevante aktuarielle Berufserfahrung im Lebensversicherungsmarkt, sei es in einer (Rück-)versicherungsgesellschaft oder in der Beratung in der Schweiz.

• Du bist Aktuar SAV oder verfügst über eine äquivalente ausländische Qualifikation.

• Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Tarifierung, Reservierung oder Reporting (OR, IFRS 17) von Lebensversicherungsprodukten.

• Du hast bereits erste Führungs- und Projekterfahrung, idealerweise in grösseren Transformationsprojekten.

• Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch – weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

• Zertifizierungen in Cloud-Technologien (z. B. Azure, AWS) oder Erfahrung mit Prozessautomatisierung bzw. -orchestrierung (z. B. Camunda) sind von Vorteil.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Consulti le principali società di assicurazione vita (e riassicurazione) in Svizzera nell'ambito di progetti di trasformazione strategica, ad esempio migrazioni di sistema, ottimizzazioni di processo o modernizzazioni di funzioni attuariali. Porti la tua esperienza specialistica attuariale in team multidisciplinari e lavori all'interfaccia tra funzioni attuariali, IT e business. Analizzi e ottimizzi modelli attuariali esistenti, processi di tariffazione o di riservazione. Assumi la responsabilità di singoli flussi di progetto o dirigi piccoli team di progetto. Supporti la creazione e lo sviluppo di relazioni con i clienti e contribuisci allo sviluppo della nostra offerta di consulenza nel settore assicurativo vita. ##
• Requisiti - Hai un titolo di studio universitario in Matematica, Statistica, Scienze attuariali o Scienze naturali. - Hai 5-8 anni di esperienza lavorativa attuariale rilevante nel mercato assicurativo vita, sia in una società di assicurazione (o riassicurazione) che in consulenza in Svizzera. - Sei attuario SAV o hai una qualifica straniera equivalente. - Hai esperienza pratica nella tariffazione, nella riservazione o nella rendicontazione (OR, IFRS 17) di prodotti assicurativi vita. - Hai già esperienza di leadership e di progetto, idealmente in progetti di trasformazione più grandi. - Commuichi in modo sicuro e negoziale in tedesco e inglese - altre lingue sono un vantaggio. - Certificazioni in tecnologie cloud (ad es. Azure, AWS) o esperienza con automazione o orchestrazione di processi (ad es. Camunda) sono vantaggiose.

B. Azure, AWS) oder Erfahrung mit Prozessautomatisierung bzw. -orchestrierung (z. B. Camunda) sind von Vorteil. ## Contatto (Non presente)
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description Vous conseillez les principales sociétés d'assurance-vie (et de réassurance) en Suisse dans le cadre de projets de transformation stratégique, tels que des migrations de systèmes, des optimisations de processus ou des modernisations de fonctions actuarielles. Vous apportez votre expertise actuarielle dans des équipes multidisciplinaires et travaillez à l'interface entre les fonctions actuarielles, informatiques et commerciales. Vous analysez et optimisez les modèles actuariels existants, les processus de tarification ou de provisionnement. Vous assumez la responsabilité de flux de projet individuels ou dirigez de petites équipes de projet. Vous soutenez le développement et l'expansion des relations avec les clients et contribuez au développement ultérieur de nos services de conseil dans le secteur de l'assurance-vie. ##
• Exigences - Vous avez un diplôme universitaire en mathématiques, statistiques, sciences actuarielles ou sciences naturelles. - Vous avez 5-8 ans d'expérience professionnelle actuarielle pertinente sur le marché de l'assurance-vie, soit dans une société d'assurance (ou de réassurance) soit en conseil en Suisse. - Vous êtes actuaire SAV ou avez une qualification étrangère équivalente. - Vous avez une expérience pratique dans la tarification, la provision ou la déclaration (OR, IFRS 17) de produits d'assurance-vie. - Vous avez déjà une expérience de leadership et de projet, idéalement dans des projets de transformation plus importants. - Vous communiquez de manière sûre et négociable en allemand et en anglais - d'autres langues sont un avantage. - Les certifications en technologies cloud (par ex. Azure, AWS) ou l'expérience avec l'automatisation ou l'orchestration de processus (par ex. Camunda) sont avantageuses.

jobs.title: Senior Auditor - Treasury and Commodity Trading
jobs.description:
• Support the engagement team with the planning, execution and completion of audit tasks within group and local audits. Your focus will be on treasury and commodity trading activities of clients in different industries.

• Be involved in consulting projects covering operating model, business processes and choice and use of treasury and trading technology.

• Work on client premises, in the office and/or at home.

• Gain in-depth knowledge of a broad range of clients and will work in a motivated team, focused on finding opportunities to add value to our clients and teams and to yourself.

• Collaborate with a network of highly talented and knowledgeable experts.

• Strive to make a difference throughout the organization and act as a catalyst for change.

• Bachelor, master's degree or diploma in economics, and you are in the process or planning to accomplish an audit degree (like Swiss CPA).

• 5 to 7 years auditing experience and practice in using IFRS and or US GAAP.

• Fluent in English, any other language (specifically German) is a plus.

• Analytical skills and interpersonal skills which you demonstrate when working with your clients and teams.

• Keen to work in a team known for its sharing, communicative culture with which other staff aspire to work with and you like to be in contact with clients.

• Able to share your expertise and experience actively by coaching others.

jobs.title: Audit – Career Start im Bereich Financial Services - Herbst 2026
jobs.description:
Du bist Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur Zahlen prüft, sondern Zusammenhänge erkennt. Bei PwC im Bereich Audit - Financial Services (Banken, Asset Manager, Versicherungen) analysierst du Unternehmen: Wie erfolgreich sind sie? Wo liegen Chancen und Risiken? Wie können sie nachhaltiger werden?

Hier arbeitest du mit neugierigen und ambitionierten Menschen, um die Wirtschaft von morgen zu gestalten – digital, nachhaltig und global. Jedes Projekt ist einzigartig und bietet dir die Chance, zu wachsen und einen Unterschied zu machen.

Vielfalt ist unsere Stärke. Deine Perspektive zählt, und wir unterstützen dich, deine Ziele zu erreichen.

Du willst nicht einfach nur einen Job, sondern etwas bewirken? Willkommen bei PwC! Hier kannst du:
• Unternehmen verstehen und transformieren: Prüfe Konzern- und Jahresabschlüsse und stelle sicher, dass diese den regulatorischen Anforderungen entsprechen - vor Ort, im Office oder flexibel aus dem Homeoffice.

• Digital die Zukunft gestalten: Nutze modernste Tools, KI und Datenanalyse, um die Wirtschaftsprüfung auf ein neues Level zu heben. Deine Ideen zählen!

• Nachhaltigkeit vorantreiben: Unterstütze bei der Prüfung von ESG-Berichten und begleite Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Umweltbewusstsein und sozialer Verantwortung.

• Netzwerke aufbauen: Arbeite mit Führungsteams und CFOs zusammen und knüpfe Kontakte, die deine Karriere prägen werden.

• Verantwortung übernehmen: Entwickle deine Leadership-Skills in einem internationalen Team, das dich fördert und inspiriert. Besonders in der intensiven Busy Season von Januar bis Ostern leistest du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden.

Solltest du dir noch unsicher sein, wie der Alltag in der Wirtschaftsprüfung aussieht, dann probiere unsere Virtual Case Experience aus. In 3-4 Stunden kannst du reale betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen lösen und einen Einblick in die Praxis gewinnen.

Bei uns zählen deine Persönlichkeit, deine Skills und dein Wille, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen. Was du ausserdem mitbringen solltest:

• Einen bevorstehenden oder abgeschlossenen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, STEM oder einer anderen Studienrichtung.

• Begeisterung für Zahlen, digitale Trends und Nachhaltigkeit.

• Den Wunsch, in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mit Menschen aus verschiedenen Kulturen zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und Englisch.

• Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen mit frischen Ideen zu lösen.

Deine Perspektive - Mehr als nur ein Job
Wir wissen, dass der Start ins Berufsleben aufregend, aber auch herausfordernd sein kann. Deshalb begleiten wir dich auf deinem Weg - mit einem klaren Plan und starker Unterstützung:
• Zeitliche und finanzielle Förderung: Wir unterstützen dich umfassend bei deiner Weiterbildung zur/zum dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in. Du erhältst nicht nur finanzielle Unterstützung, sondern auch die Flexibilität, deine Lernzeit optimal zu gestalten.

• Flexibilität, die zu dir passt: Unsere Arbeitszeitmodelle geben dir die Freiheit, Beruf, Lernen und Freizeit in Einklang zu bringen.

• Mentoring und Entwicklung: Du wirst von erfahrenen Kolleg:innen begleitet, die dich fördern und inspirieren.

• Ein Team, das dich stärkt: Bei uns findest du eine Gemeinschaft, die Vielfalt schätzt, Ideen feiert und dich ermutigt, über dich hinauszuwachsen.

Warum PwC? Weil wir wissen, was dir wichtig ist. Sinnvolle Arbeit, die einen Unterschied macht. Ein Team, das dich inspiriert. Und die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Community of Solvers. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung - digital, nachhaltig und global.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Fai parte di un team che non solo controlla i numeri, ma riconosce anche le connessioni. In PwC nel dipartimento Audit - Servizi finanziari (banche, gestori patrimoniali, compagnie assicurative) analizzi le aziende: quanto successo hanno? Dove sono le opportunità e i rischi? Come possono diventare più sostenibili? Qui lavorerai con persone curiose e ambiziose per dare forma all'economia di domani: digitale, sostenibile e globale. Ogni progetto è unico e ti offre l'opportunità di crescere e fare la differenza. La diversità è la nostra forza. La tua prospettiva conta e noi ti supportiamo nel raggiungimento dei tuoi obiettivi. Non vuoi solo un lavoro, vuoi fare la differenza? Benvenuto in PwC! Qui puoi:
• Comprendere e trasformare le aziende: controlla i rendiconti finanziari consolidati e annuali e assicurati che soddisfino i requisiti normativi - in loco, in ufficio o in modo flessibile dal tuo ufficio a casa.
• Plasmare il futuro in modo digitale: utilizzare strumenti all'avanguardia, intelligenza artificiale e analisi dei dati per portare l'auditing a un nuovo livello. Le tue idee contano!
• Promuovere la sostenibilità: supportare la revisione dei report ESG e accompagnare le aziende nel loro percorso verso una maggiore consapevolezza ambientale e responsabilità sociale.
• Costruisci reti: collabora con team di leadership e CFO e crea connessioni che daranno forma alla tua carriera.
• Assumiti la responsabilità: sviluppa le tue capacità di leadership in un team internazionale che ti supporta e ti ispira. Date un contributo decisivo al successo dei nostri clienti, soprattutto nell'intensa stagione da gennaio a Pasqua. Se non sei ancora sicuro di come sia la vita quotidiana nell'auditing, prova la nostra esperienza di caso virtuale. In 3-4 ore puoi risolvere domande aziendali reali e acquisire una visione pratica. Ciò che conta per noi è la tua personalità, le tue capacità e la tua voglia di rendere il mondo un posto migliore. Cosa dovresti portare con te:
• Una laurea o un master imminente o completato in economia, informatica (aziendale), STEM o un altro campo di studio.
• Entusiasmo per i numeri, i trend digitali e la sostenibilità.
• Il desiderio di lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e di collaborare con persone provenienti da culture diverse.
• Forti capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese.
• Spirito di squadra e capacità di risolvere le sfide con idee nuove. La tua prospettiva - Molto più di un semplice lavoro Sappiamo che iniziare la tua vita professionale può essere entusiasmante ma anche impegnativo. Ecco perché ti accompagniamo nel tuo percorso - con un piano chiaro e un forte supporto:
• Supporto temporale e finanziario: ti forniamo un supporto completo nella tua formazione continua per diventare un qualificato. Revisore dei conti. Non solo riceverai supporto finanziario, ma anche la flessibilità per organizzare in modo ottimale il tuo tempo di apprendimento.
• La flessibilità adatta a te: i nostri modelli di orario di lavoro ti danno la libertà di conciliare lavoro, apprendimento e tempo libero.
• Mentoring e sviluppo: sarai supportato da colleghi esperti che ti sosterranno e ti ispireranno.
• Un team che ti rafforza: con noi troverai una comunità che valorizza la diversità, celebra le idee e ti incoraggia a crescere oltre te stesso. Perchè PwC? Perché sappiamo cosa è importante per te. Un lavoro significativo che fa la differenza. Una squadra che ti ispira. E l’opportunità di plasmare attivamente il futuro. Candidati ora ed entra a far parte della nostra community di risolutori. Insieme stiamo dando forma al futuro della revisione contabile: digitale, sostenibile e globale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
You are part of a team that not only checks numbers, but also recognizes connections. At PwC in the Audit - Financial Services department (banks, asset managers, insurance companies) you analyze companies: How successful are they? Where are the opportunities and risks? How can they become more sustainable? Here you will work with curious and ambitious people to shape the economy of tomorrow - digital, sustainable and global. Every project is unique and offers you the opportunity to grow and make a difference. Diversity is our strength. Your perspective counts, and we support you in achieving your goals. You don't just want a job, you want to make a difference? Welcome to PwC! Here you can:
• Understand and transform companies: Check consolidated and annual financial statements and ensure that they meet regulatory requirements - on site, in the office or flexibly from your home office.
• Shaping the future digitally: Use state-of-the-art tools, AI and data analysis to take auditing to a new level. Your ideas count!
• Drive sustainability: Support the review of ESG reports and accompany companies on their path to greater environmental awareness and social responsibility.
• Build networks: Collaborate with leadership teams and CFOs and make connections that will shape your career.
• Take responsibility: Develop your leadership skills in an international team that supports and inspires you. You make a crucial contribution to the success of our customers, especially in the intense busy season from January to Easter. If you are still unsure what everyday life in auditing looks like, then try out our Virtual Case Experience. In 3-4 hours you can solve real business questions and gain an insight into practice. What counts for us is your personality, your skills and your desire to make the world a better place. What you should also bring with you:
• An upcoming or completed bachelor's or master's degree in economics, (business) information technology, STEM or another field of study.
• Enthusiasm for numbers, digital trends and sustainability.
• The desire to work in an international environment and collaborate with people from different cultures.
• Strong communication skills in German and English.
• Team spirit and the ability to solve challenges with fresh ideas. Your perspective - More than just a job We know that starting your professional life can be exciting but also challenging. That's why we accompany you on your path - with a clear plan and strong support:
• Time and financial support: We provide you with comprehensive support in your further training to become a qualified. Auditor. You not only receive financial support, but also the flexibility to optimally organize your learning time.
• Flexibility that suits you: Our working time models give you the freedom to balance work, learning and leisure time.
• Mentoring and development: You will be supported by experienced colleagues who will support and inspire you.
• A team that strengthens you: With us you will find a community that values ​​diversity, celebrates ideas and encourages you to grow beyond yourself. Why PwC? Because we know what’s important to you. Meaningful work that makes a difference. A team that inspires you. And the opportunity to actively shape the future. Apply now and become part of our Community of Solvers. Together we are shaping the future of auditing - digital, sustainable and global.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Risk Consulting Financial Services (Technology)
jobs.description:
Join a dynamic team that prides itself on being true partners to a diverse clientele, including banking, insurance, multinationals, and smaller organizations. We focus on solving complex problems through impactful and transformational projects, both large and small.
Our team is a unique blend of specialists and all-rounders, fostering a culture of mutual support and shared growth. We value collaboration, ensuring that everyone's contributions uplift team performance and enhance client outcomes. We offer an engaging work culture that promotes continuous learning and professional development, providing opportunities to work on diverse projects that challenge and expand your expertise.

• Engage with clients to understand their risk technology needs and deliver tailored solutions.

• Implement leading GRC platforms, ensuring they align with client-specific risk strategies and compliance requirements.

• Assess technology risks across client environments and provide actionable insights for improvement.

• Advise clients on integrating risk intelligence into their technology landscapes for optimized decision-making.

• Lead risk transformation initiatives and drive digital enablement in the financial services industry.

• Driving teams to embed risk technology in delivery and collaborate regularly with PwC Global for alignment.

• Representing and growing our risk technology presence in the market.

• Strong expertise in risk technology and building partnerships with alliances and PwC Global. You will be the key contact to ensure the right tools are used for clients.

• Deep understanding of Risk Management Frameworks including COSO, ISO 31000, NIST, and COBIT.

• Expertise in Technology Risk.

• Proficiency with GRC Platforms such as RSA Archer, ServiceNow GRC, MetricStream, LogicGate, and OpenPages.

• Familiarity with Enterprise Applications Risk including SAP GRC and Oracle Risk Management Cloud.

• Utilize Data & Analytics in Risk by leveraging tools like Power BI, Tableau, Python, and SQL for risk analysis, dashboards, and anomaly detection.

• Experience with Emerging Tech in Risk, including cloud risk on AWS and Azure, AI/ML model governance, blockchain risk, and third-party risk management (TPRM) platforms.

If you're a seasoned Risk Technology professional passionate about transforming risk management within technology environments, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join a team that truly values innovation, collaboration, and excellence in client service.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager - Cyber Technology and Transformation
jobs.description:
Are you ready to contribute to the successful delivery of Cyber Technology & Transformation engagements?
This is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing Cyber Technology and Transformation team. We support our clients along the whole cyber security journey, ranging from technology assessments, identification and implementation of cyber solutions, defining cyber strategy and many more. You benefit from a great team to work with and from our broad engagements enabling you to growth personally and professionally.

• Be part of our diverse Cybersecurity team and play a pivotal role in delivering security engagements spanning Exposure Management, Security Architecture, Cloud Security, and many more.

• Serve as key contact for our clients, taking on the end-to-end management and successful delivery of our engagements.

• Provide strategic guidance to clients to support them on their cyber journey.

• Drive the evaluation and implementation of cyber technologies to improve the cybersecurity maturity of our clients.

• Build and drive your own cyber capability, from business development to contributing to the development of innovative services within our cyber technology and transformation practice.

• Shape and mentor cross-functional teams to develop and execute long term client relationships and to accelerate a collaborative work environment.

• Min. 5 years of relevant experience in Cybersecurity and prior consulting experience from either a consultancy firm or an internal corporate consulting function or role.

• Master's or bachelor's degree or an equivalent professional qualification. Additional certificates such as CISSP, CISM, SSCP are a plus.

• Knowledge and hands on experience in managing security projects in key domains such as security operations, security architecture, Identity and Access Management (IAM), cloud security etc.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with all levels of management and staff.

• Fluent in English; German or French are a plus.

• Drive the evaluation and implementation of cyber technologies to improve the cybersecurity maturity of our clients.
• Build and drive your own cyber capability, from business development to contributing to the development of innovative services within our cyber technology and transformation practice.
• Shape and mentor cross-functional teams to develop and execute long term client relationships and to accelerate a collaborative work environment.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with all levels of management and staff.
